'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen pa'i phyi rten du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten/ gangs ri'i phung po ltar mtho zhing dkar ba/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las gser gdugs gser 'phru dang bcas pa/ 'phangs mtho zhing lhun chags par grub ste rab gnas kyi byin chags par mdzad do// gzhan yang gser las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mang du bzhengs shing*/ ras bris la yang*/ thub dbang gi skyes rabs mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i zhing bkod sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i rtogs brjod kyi zhing khams so sor bkod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor mang po dang*/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar gyi thang ka sogs te/ lo re'i nang du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten brgya las ma nyung ba bzhengs pa'i dam bca' yang mdzad cing*/ khyad par sgrub brgyud 'di'i bla ma rgya bod kyi tshad ldan du ma'i bka' 'bum rnams rim pa bzhin mthing shog ngos la gser gyis 'bur du bzhengs shing*/ deng sang ni yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'o// de'i dus khams skyo'i dbon po gnyis kyis thog drangs 'dan ma'i 'phrin las pa rnams zhabs drung du sleb cing*/| grwa pa brgya yi gtsug phud kyang bzhes par mdzad cing*/ bstan pa'i phrin las kyi rgyun btsugs nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de rnams kyis kyang*/ zhabs tog gi mnyes par mdzad cing*/ 'dan ma'i yul du bstan pa'i rgyun bzung ngo*// de nas dus kyi pho nya zhes bya ba rta'i lo la/ gcen po rin chen rnam par rgyal bas/ rje btsun byams pa chen po'i sku bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod dang*/ rab gnas la rje btsun 'di nyid spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ grub rtags dang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can gyis der gnas kyi skye dgu rnams kyi yid 'phrog par byed pa mtha' yas pa byung ba'o// de nas slar yang 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du phebs te/

rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mos dus 'da' bar mdzad cing*/ dad 'dus kyi gdul bya'i tshogs la chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor zhing*/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/| don grub zhes bya ba sa mo lug gi lo la/ stag lung gwa zi'i gdung rigs sde pa tshe dbang grags pa sku gshegs las/ thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs dang*/ yar 'dren gyi gral dbu sogs ji ltar bgyi ba'i bka' bgros pa'i tshe/ bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes shing smon lam rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor ba'i skyes mchog 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i mkhas grub chen po/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po spyan drangs na rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par dgongs te gsol btab pas/ rje nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes te/ rje btsun 'khor bcas stag lung du phebs tshe/ stag lung chos rje rnams kyis phyag mdzad cing*/ rje btsun nyid kyis kyang phyag lan mdzad de phan tshun dgyes pa'i ngang du bzhugs so// de nas dus tshes gza' skar 'dzom pa'i snga dro'i cha la/ stag lung bla g.yel chen por/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su seng ge'i khri rnam par brjid pa'i steng du/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i rnam par sprul pa/ rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid kyis/ zab cing snyan pa'i tshangs pa'i gsung gis/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab cing*/ stag lung nang sos kyang lha mi'i dpal 'byor phyogs gcig tu spungs pa lta bu'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams rje 'di nyid kyi phyag tu phul lo// phyi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ theg mchog chos kyi bdud rtsi zab mos dge slong gi dge 'dun nyis stong brgyad brgya'i tshogs thams cad tshim par mdzad cing*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang dad pa dang mos pa chen po'i sgo nas/

snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs thams cad du 'brug sgra ltar sgrog cing*/ sgrub pa dang zang zing gi zhabs tog la sogs te mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas so// slar yang rje btsun nyid kyis kyang*/ tshogs chen la 'gyed kyi bye brag dpag tu med pa dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do// de nas rje btsun rnam gnyis thugs yid 'dres pa'i dag pa'i snang ba rgya chen po'i ngang nas/ rje btsun 'di nyid 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du phebs te/ 'gro ba'i don du 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs so// de nas drag po zhes pa lcags pho sprel gyi lo la/ skyi shod lung par nad yams chen po byung nas/ mi bsam gyis mi khyab pa shi ba dang*/ dpyid du char ba gcig kyang ma bab par than pa shin tu che ba byung bas/ zhing gi ljang pa dang*/ rtsa dang lo ma rnams kyang rang sar bskams/ mtsho dang rdzing bu phal cher yang bskams pas/| chu la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyang tshe'i dus byas par gyur to// de'i dus mthu stobs dang nus pas rgyal phran thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ nang du theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod cing phyi ltar rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas mnga' 'bangs dge bcu'i khrims la sbyor ba bod shing sgo 'jug pa'i bdag po/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid/ bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ rje btsun chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid nyams dang rtogs pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ 'gro ba'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ skye 'gro dpag tu med pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i snyan pa'i grags pa mi dbang don yod rdo rje'i snyan du gsan pas/ dga' bde'i dpal gyi lus kyi mtsho chen gang nas/ dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos yid kyi klu dbang bskul te/

sprul pa'i skyes mchog de dang mjal bar gyur na bdag kyang skye 'chi 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i mos pa skyes te/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid spyan 'dren zhus pa'i tshe/ rgyal dbang 'di nyid dpon slob kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas skyid shod du phebs pa las/ brag dkar rdzong du rdzong dpon sri gcod pas gdan 'dren zhus te/ zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas/ de'i dus de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag gi rnam sprul zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa/| chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po gdan sa mthil gyi spyan snga'i khur bzung nas yod dus/ rje nyid mjal 'phrad mdzad phyir/ lha sa 'phrul snang du phebs te bzhugs pa dang*/ sa skyong yon mchod kyis/ thab 'dzin kyi ja 'dren bzang po dang bcas te 'brom smad glang rar phebs so// de'i tshe sa skyong don yod rdo rjes thog drangs pa'i skyid shod lung pa'i mi rnams mgrin gcig tu nad yams 'chad cing char 'babs pa'i 'dod don mgon po 'di nyid la gsol ba 'di ltar btab bo// kye ma gson dang rje btsun 'bri gung pa// snyigs dus skye bo skal ba dman pa'i mthus// chos pa rnams kyang phal cher rnam g.yeng spyod// dkar phyogs lha rnams bag med dbang du song*/| /|nag phyogs 'byung po rnams kyi mnga' thang rgyas// skye bo phal cher nad dang mu ges nyen// mgon med 'di rnams mgon dang bcas par mdzod// khyod kyis mthu rtsal sbyar ba'i dus la bab// 'di 'dra'i dus na khyod 'dras mi skyob na// btsan sar sleb nas khyod kyis ci zhig bya// zhes sogs gsol ba rgyas par btab pa las/ rje nyid kyis thugs rje tshad med pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis thugs rgyud bskul te/ klu chen brgyad la gtor ma sbyin nas phrin las bcol bas/| skad cig de nyid la/ dus las yol ba'i rlung drag po langs/

phyogs mtshams kun nas sprin nag mang po 'khrigs/ 'brug sgra drag po grags te/ char drag la rgyun ring ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bab pas/ sa phyogs thams cad chus gang bar gyur te/ ljang pa dang rtsi thog thams cad kyang rgyas/ mtsho dang rdzing bu thams cad kyang gang*/ sa chen 'di yang sngo zhing mdzes pa in+d+ra nī la'i ljongs lta bur gyur/ chu la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi tshe yang thar/ de ga'i mod la nad yams thams cad kyang chad par gyur to// de'i tshe sa skyong chen pos thog drangs pa'i skye bo thams cad shin tu dad pa'i mos gus tshad zung med pa skyes par gyur to/| /|de nas sa skyong don yod rdo rje rang gi phyag tu spos phor thogs te/ chas bzang dpal dang ldan pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag 'tshal sgang nas bsu ba mdzad de/ smon grong skyed tshal du phebs te/ yon mchod 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i dga' ston mdzad nas/ smon grong gzhis khar bzhugs gnas kyang mdzad do// de'i nang par 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs te/ gtsug lag khang nas/ smon grong gzhis kha'i bar thams cad mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas bsu ba'i tshul ni/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang*/ phye ma phur ma la sogs pa dar cha'i tshogs dang rnga dang dung dang sil snyan dang*/| pi wang dang rgya gling la sogs pa rol mo'i tshogs rnams dang*/ a ka ru dang rgya spos dang*/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po la sogs te spos kyi bye brag mang po dang*/| dge 'dun brgya phrag du mas mchod pa'i bye brag du ma thogs pa'i ser sbrengs dang*/ khye'u dang bu mo'i tshogs rnams mdzes pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan te glu gar gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i ngang nas rje btsun nyid kyi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta ba la sogs pa'i bsu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te/ rje btsun nyid phebs pa las/

zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pas kyang*/ 'phrul snang gi bar sgo ru bsu ba mdzad de/ dad pa'i gdung bas/ phyag kyang mnyam por mdzad nas/| seng ge'i khri mnyam par bkod pa'i steng du/ rgyal dbang gnyis kyang mnyam por bzhugs so// rgyal ba 'bri gung pa 'khor bcas g.yas gral dang*/ rgyal ba chos kyi grags pa 'khor bcas g.yon gral dang*/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje sogs dbus gtsang gi sde bdag thams cad yar 'gyur bzhugs so// de'i tshe ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dga' ston bzang po ni/ rnam thos kyi bu'i dpal dang mtshungs pa'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa la tshim pa drug gis longs spyad pa'o// de ga'i mod la rje btsun de nyid shākya mu ne'i drung du mjal ba'i tshe/ jo bo'i sku las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga byung ste/ rje nyid kyis thugs khar thim pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma ston par mdzad/ de nas jo shaka mched gnyis la sogs pa'i 'phrul snang gi ngo mtshar ba'i sku'i rten thams cad la zhal gser dang*/ na bza' dang*/ snyan dar dang*/| nyin mtshan dpag tu med pa 'bar ba'i mar me bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par byas so// de'i dus kyi zhal gser 'bul ba dang*/ spyan dbye ba rnams ni/ sprul sku sman thang bas bgyis pa las/ 'di 'dra'i gser sna bzhin mdangs bzang ba ni/ sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong bas rje btsun 'di'i grub rtags rang du 'dug go zer zhing*/ sprul sku sman thang ba yang mi brjed pa'i dad pa thob ste gsung chos kyang zhus so// de nas dpal mi'i dbang po sa skyong don yod rdo rjes rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhabs spyi bos blangs nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid gdan mngon par bkod pa seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/

sprul pa'i rgyal po don yod rdo rjes thog drangs pa'i ma nges pa'i 'khor sna tshogs pa khri phrag du ma la/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang rang gi sems yid ma tshim gyi bar du bskor ba lags so// de'i tshe lha dang mkha' 'gros/ nam mkha' nas me tog gi char dpag tu med pa 'bebs par byas te/ bar snang thams cad me tog gi gang ste/ me tog la la ni nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin du g.yo bar byed/ kha cig ni sa steng du 'phur te 'bab/ me tog la la ni bar snang la lding zhing 'khor/ kha cig ni babs shing babs shing slar yang lding*/ me tog la la ni kha dog lnga ldan du 'bab/ kha cig ni nyi zer dang mnyam du 'khor bar snang ngo*// 'ja' 'od kyang 'ga' zhig ni 'khyil zhing skor ba dang*/| la la dag bla re dang yol ba bzhin bkra bar byung ba sogs bar snang thams cad mchod pa'i me tog dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i tshe/ de ltar mthong ba'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams ni/ ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan par gyur nas/ bltas pas tshim pa dang ngoms pa med par bkres skom ngal ba'i 'du shes la sogs pa/ tha mal pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams rang bzhin gyis 'gags te/ rje btsun nyid la dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yos nas/ mig mchi ma dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen pos byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rjes bzung zhig la sogs pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gang yod kyi dngos po 'bul ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa/ smon lam 'debs pa la brtson par gyur pa lags so// de lta bu'i ltas khyad par can mthong bas/ sprul pa'i rgyal po don yod rdo rje slar yang mi brjed pa'i dad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang nas nyin re bzhin jo bo'i drung du yon mchod phyogs mthun du smon lam rgya chen po yang mdzad do// de nas rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la mnga' brnyes shing rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rgyal tshab tu gyur kyang*/

da dung chos la chog shes pa'i bdud las rgyal ba'i phyir/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i drung du/ gsung chos gsan pa'i tshul ni 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ gdan bzhi yab yum dang*/ ma hā ma yā dang*/| 'jam dpal gsang ldan la sogs te dbang bka' mang po dang*/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud dang*/ snying po skor drug la sogs te/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung mang po gsan par mdzad do// de nas yon mchod thams cad thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas/ thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ sa skyong de nyid kyi bkod pas khyab par mdzad pa ni/ nyi ma re re bzhin yang zas sna phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gar dang*/ 'cham dang*/ ku dang bro la sogs pa'i sgo nas kyang mchod par mdzad do// de nas slar yang rgyal po'i pho brang po ta la zhes bya bar gdan 'dren zhus/ rgya ja'i mchog dang*/ bu ram dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ 'bras can la sogs te/ zas sna brgya phrag las lhag pa'i grangs kyi bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'bul ba'i khyad par phyag tu btang ba ni/ ngo mtshar byin rlabs che ba'i rten gsum du ma dang*/ gser spyad dang dngul spyad dang*/ gan dkar la sogs gsol spyad cha tshang ba dang*/ gos 'bol la sogs pa gzim chas cha tshang ba dang*/ ber thul la sogs te na bza'i tshogs cha tshang dang*/ gser dngul la sogs te rin po che'i rnam grangs du ma dang*/ gzhan yang ja sig dang*/ snam dos dang*/ spos dos/ dkar dos/ ras dos la sogs te 'bul ba'i tshogs rnams kyi bkod pa ni/ tshangs pa'i dpal 'byor kyang zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du ste/ re re'i ming nas brjod par mi nus pa yin no// gzhan yang sku 'khor mkhan slob chos gsum/ nye gnas chen po/ gsol gzim 'gron gsum la sogs pa che dgu rnams dang*/ mdor na las 'dzin du gtogs pa rta rdzi/ mdzo rdzi yan chod du gyur pa rnams la/ rang rang gi 'dod pa'i re ba rdzogs par mdzad pa yin no// rgyal dbang nyid kyis kyang sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis brjod de/

me tog 'thor bar mdzad pas/ me tog gi char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung ngo*/| /|de nas slar yang 'phrul snang gi khyams khra chen mo ru/ rin po che'i khri dang gral bkod sngar bzhin du bshams pa la/ phan tshun mnyam por bzhugs so// de nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa rang gi khri las bzhengs te/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po'i drung du byon te/ gan dkar rgya jas bkang ba rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po'i phyag tu phul lo/| /|rgyal dbang des kyang*/ rang gi khri las 'phags nas/ gus pa'i tshul kyis bcud de bzhes so// de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog tu gyur pa mang po dang*/| lha dang mi'i rin po che du ma dang*/ rin chen gser gyi gan pa'i gos la sogs pa khyad nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni/ pha cher rje rang nyid kyis rgyal dbang 'bri gung pa'i phyag tu 'bul bar mdzad do// gzhan yang rnam grangs rgya 'bul stong 'bul gyi bkod pa ni/ sa steng 'di na 'gran zla med par gyur pa mthun grub tu der 'dus kyi skye bo dag smra bar gyur to// drung 'khor rnams la yang gang la gang 'os kyi tshim par mdzad do// de nas rje btsun dam pa gnyis po thugs yid dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur kyang*/ gdul bya'i dbang gi sku lus gnyis su mdzad nas/ phyag gnyis gcig la gcig gis 'jus te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa sogs/ zhal bkod kyi bslab bya yang mang du mdzad pa'i mthar/ phan tshun gcig la gcig 'phreng bzhin du rang rang gi gdul bya'i zhing du 'byon par bzhed de/ sprul pa'i rgyal po sa skyong 'khor bcas kyis lha sa'i phyag 'tshal sgang gi bar du skyel thung mdzad/ yar lam chu bo'i rags la phyag nas kyang mdzad pas/ chu bo de la gnas pa'i klu dbang de dag dad pa'i dbang gis bka' la nyan te chu yi gnod pa lo grangs du ma'i bar du zhi bar byas so// de nas yon mchod gnyis kyang dgongs pa gcig tu 'dres te/

sa skyong chen pos rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba dang*/ khyad par 'bri gung rin po che'i sde srid kyi zhabs 'degs gang dgongs bdag la babs so zhes yang yang zhus nas/ dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis phyag mang po 'tshal te/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas smon lam rgya chen po btab bo// rje nyid kyis kyang*/ dad pa'i rten du thugs dam phreng ba zhig gnang nas sprul pa'i sa skyong chen po la shis pa rgya chen po brjod pa yin no// de nas rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chain po 'khor dang bcas pa thugs dgyes pa chen po'i ngang nas bde bar phebs te/ 'bri gung 'og min chos kyi pho brang gi thog kha gser gyi khang par/ snying po'i rnal 'byor la g.yel ba med par bzhugs so// de nas dgun khrid la gsung chos zab la rgya che ba gsungs pa'i rjes su/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas/ rjes su bzung tshul zur tsam zhig smos pa ni/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ rje rang nyid kyis gsungs pa ni/ 'bri gung du dgun khrid thon pa'i rjes su/ nub gcig gi rmang lam lta bu la/ kho bo thog kha gser khang na 'dug pa las/ gser khang steng gi gzhal yas khang du/ bla ma 'ba' zhig gis gang nas/ thams cad bzhugs gral byas pa'i dbu la/ bka' rtags kyi sgom zhwa gsol/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum bzhes/ sgom thag thogs pa can sha stag tshogs 'dug pa'i nang nas/ bla ma sku sha smug pa 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che lta bu dang bcas pa'ang snang*/ de'i nang nas bla ma gcig mnyam med sgam po rin po che yin zer ba zhig sku sha dkar la zhal dkyus ring ba/ khyad par zhal ma ne ring ba/ sgom zhwa bka' rtags kyi rgyan can/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba zhig gis bdag la/ mu tig snyim pa gang gnang nas 'di khyod kyi grwa pa yin gsung ba byung bas/ sems can 'ga' la phan thogs cung zhig yong ba 'dra snyam pa'i nges pa'i shes pa zhig byung*/ de'i rjes su yang nub gcig rmi lam du/

rang gi lus las rnag khrag babs pa de/ khang pa gcig gang ba tsam thon pa rmis te sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags su go/| de'i rjes su nub gcig rmi lam du/ 'bri gung gi thang 'di thams cad mar me'i kong bus gang ba/ sdong ras btsugs pa 'ba' zhig mthong bas/ bdag gis gcig bsgron nas/ des thams cad sgron pa zhig rmis pa 'di'ang*/ dgun khrid kyi dus yin pas/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis 'ga' zhig la phan thogs par yang go zhing*/| yang re zhig tshe na/ sgrub sde'i gnas su 'gro ba'i nub gcig rmi lam la/ rdza ma mang po me tog rgya men gyi gang nas skyes 'dug pa la/ me tog la la shar ba/| la la 'char rgyu/ la la 'char la khad pas gang bar snang zhing*/ bdag kyang lus la chos gos dri ma med pa zhig gyon nas 'gro zhing 'dug pa zhig byung bas/ sgrub sde 'di la phan cung zad cig thogs pa 'dra snyam pa yang byung*/ gzhan yang bla ma rnams kyi dngos su 'gro don gyis shig khyad par dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la 'bungs zhes bka' gnang ba sbyin pa'o// de rnams ni rje btsun rang nyid kyi gsung las cha zur tsam byung ba'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/| /|de nas rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyi thugs rje dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ theg dman gyi log lta thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje la sogs pa'i sde bdag thams cad dbang du 'dus nas rnam dkar gyi las la bkod cing*/ dbus gtsang gi yongs 'dzin phal cher gyis/| dad pa'i spu long g.yos te rje 'di nyid zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs nas zhal gyi bdud rtsi myangs pas/ 'khrul med kyi thar pa'i lam rnam par dag pa la bkod pa sogs/| rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa lags so// 'dir smras pa/ thugs rje'i mnga' bdag sprul sku 'dzam gling rgyan// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i 'bri gung pa// khyod nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der// lha mi kun gyis mchod cing me tog 'thor// gus pas bstod cing mos pas gsol ba 'debs// mthong thos dran reg thar pa'i lam la bkod// deng sang bstan pa'i bdag po khyod nyid tsam// dad ldan thar pa 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams// mgon po 'di la rtse gcig gsol ba thob// thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'jug par the tshom med// ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/

rje btsun nyid kyi rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu la dad pas rjes su yi rang ba'o// rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las/ drang nges kyi chos kyi bdud rtsis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung bsal nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pas mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa'i le'u lnga pa'o// ༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyi mdzad pa drug pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur sogs/| sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa la sogs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba rlabs po che'i mdzad pa bstan pa ni/| bya lo'i dus dgung lo nyer bdun bzhes pa bya lo la babs pa na/ byang phyogs su sgom sde dang*/ khyung po sogs skye bo mang po phan tshun gcig la gcig 'tshe zhing gnod par byed pa la/ rje btsun nyid kyis byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis 'og tu bcug pa'i 'khrug pa rnams bsdums pas/ thams cad phan tshun 'tshe ba dang bral zhing nang mi ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur pa'o// de ltar rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag yin pas/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa brnyes te/ skal ldan gdul bya rnams la rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas tshigs don sbas pa'i don rnams kyang gsal bar mdzad cing*/ mdo sde rin po che nas legs par gsungs pa'i lag len rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag sa lam gyi sbyor tshul bstan pa rin po che'i lam rim gyi snying rnams tshig don gyi mtha' chod pa'i sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i snying po/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid/ 'gro ba'i don du rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/

khyad par 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas/ gnas gsum gyi ri pa 'chag med rdzong ba'i phyag srol yod pa bzhin ma nyams par bya ba'i phyir gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi ri khrod du/ sgrub sde 'dzugs par mdzad pa ni/ rang rang gi rdor 'dzin ri thebs dang bcas pa la sgrub rgyags dang*/ sgrub pa'i dam bca' dang bcas nas rgyun ma chad par rdzong bar mdzad do// khyad par 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du/ gling kha dar rgyas rtse zhes bya bar/ sgrub sde thar pa'i gru chen 'di nyid 'dzugs par mdzad cing*/ bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgo nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams legs par bsdus te/ de dag gi nang nas snying rus dang zhe bcad mchog tu gyur pa rnams smra bcad dang*/ 'dag sbyar gyi dus 'da' bar mdzad cing*/ bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba rlabs chen mdzad pa ni/ 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no// rje btsun 'di nyid 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos kyi khri la phebs nas/ dbus gtsang gi dus 'khrug phal cher yang rang sar zhi ba dang*/ log lta'i theg dman gyi bstan pa yang cung zad bri bar gyur/ 'bri gung byang chub gling 'di nyid kyang*/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs kyis gang ste/ la la ni dka' spyad dang du blangs te snying po'i sgrub pa la brtson/ kha cig ni bsod nams kyi dpal 'byor rgyas te/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpal la spyod/ la la ni rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rgyas te/ gsung rab la sbyangs pa byed/ kha cig ni mi rtag 'chi ba dran te/ skye med kyi rang sa 'dzin/ la la ni bla ma'i bka' drin dran te/ gdung shugs kyi gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs te/ nyin mtshan chos kyi 'da' bar mdzad pa yang ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa'o// gzhan yang rje 'di nyid kyi sku la bsdo ba'i dgra bo rnams la/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i snying rje chen po'i sgo nas/

thugs 'khrugs pa'i rnam pa mi mnga' yang phrin las sgrub pa'i dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyis tshar bcad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ sne'u rdzong pa sde ris dang bcas pas mi gdug pa'i tsha rngam chen po bstan pa la/ de ga'i mod la bde skyid dang bral nas/ phyis mi rgyud rtsa ba nas brlag par gyur pa kun gyis mthong ba 'di ltar yin no// gzhan yang kong po sogs kyi mi srun pa'i skye bo mang pos/| gnod pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma bstan pa rnams kyang*/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang bral nas phyis 'gyod nas bshags pa byed pa yang mang dag byung zhing*/ de nas bzung ste 'bri gung pa'i phyogs la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i sbyor ba rtsom pa la zhugs pa thams cad/ de ga'i mod la pham par byas te/ me tog gsar pa la ba mo drag po phog pa bzhin du gyur nas/ dgra bgegs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen por grags pa'o// de'i phyir rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi phrin las dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyis rtsol med du sgrub par shes par bya'o// de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rje nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ kho bo mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du yod dus/ nub cig rmi lam lta bu la/ rang nyid kyi lag 'og gnyis su bya rog gdong snum pa legs pa gnyis gnas pa mthong ste/ 'di ni gzhi'i gnas lugs kyi rtsa gnyis la rten pa'i gdong can mthong bar mngon/ yang thog kha gser khang na yod pa'i dus shig la/ ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor rgyas pa ma tshang ba med pa gzi 'od dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ sku mdog ser 'jam du snang ba dang mjal te/ 'di ni kun da lus la brtan pa'i dus su mthong bar mngon no// de lta bu'i snang tshul las rjes su bzung ba'i mdun pa byas te/ bsnyen pa mchod gtor la 'bad pas/ 'phrin las rtsol med du sgrub pa yin no gsungs so// gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las sgrub tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de rjes su bstan par bya'o// de'i tshe gong du bstan pa ltar 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling 'di dar zhing rgyas par gyur te/

dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs kyi mkhas grub thams cad 'dus nas/ rje btsun gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pas nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin du gyur to// dam pa 'di'i de snga yan gyi bu chen slob ma'i tshogs rnams byung tshul mdo tsam brjod na/| mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa dwags po paṇa chen gsung rab mang thos zhes pa dang*/ gnas lnga rig pa'i chos la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/ grub chen rgyal po don grub rnam rgyal zhes bya ba dang*/ mal gro grub chen blo gros dpal ldan pa zhes pa dang*/ skyabs rje rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho zhes pa dang*/ grub chen ngag dbang grags pa zhes bya ba dang*/ mkhas grub rnam rgyal mgon po zhes bya ba dang*/ grub chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dang*/| mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa dkyil 'khor brgya phrag du ma la dbang sgyur zhing*/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi smin grol gyi gdams pa mtha' dag thugs su chud pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog cig car rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa'i grub chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ jo gdan mkhan chen blo gros brtan pa zhes bya ba dang*/| mkhan chen legs rin pa zhes pa dang*/ sgru sgang bla ma tshul khrims 'od zer zhes pa dang*/ 'bri gung slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen zhes pa dang*/ chos sgo ba dpal 'byor grags pa zhes pa dang*/ spo bo chos rje kun dga' rgyal po zhes pa la sogs pa'i thugs sras bu chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba mang po dang*/ yon tan gyi khur chen bsnams pa'i che bgres mang po dang*/ rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs pa'i rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa brgya stong du ma dang*/ rgyun tu bug sgo 'dag sbyar mdzad pa'i ri khrod pa brgya phrag du ma dang*/

dge sbyor ngo mthong gi rnal 'byor pa khri phrag tsam la sogs te rags pa tsam brjod pa'o// de ltar mi'i gdul bya rnams smin grol la dngos su bkod pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i gdul bya yang thar pa'i lam la bkod tshul yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams bya rgod kyi gzugs su byas nas chos nyan pa dang*/ gzugs mi mngon pa'i phyag dang bskor ba byed pa'i 'ur sgra chen po byung ba dang*/ ri dwags kyis bskor ba byed pa mngon sum du mthong ba dang*/ dam can rdo rje legs pa sogs kyis bka' nyan phrin las sgrub pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang bden stobs brjod pas/ klung dang nags la me shor ba yang rang sar zhi zhing*/ chu bo rnams la yang bden stobs brjod pas/ ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin 'grub pa la sogs pa bden tshig mngon sum du grub pa la the tshom med do// de ltar mkhyen brtse dang mthu stobs kyi bdag nyid/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi blo dang 'tsham par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas phrin las bstan pa'i bdag po chen po ni gyur/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pas/| log par lta ba'i bstan dgra ma rungs pa thams cad ni zil gyis non/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas/ gzhan gyis brdzi ba med pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni thob/ thog ma med pa nas smon lam dang thugs rje'i shugs drag pos sprul pa'i zhabs rim sgrub pa'i skyes bu stobs dang ldan zhing gus pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis dgongs pa ni sgrub/ 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i bshad sgrub kyi gru bo chen po ni legs par tshugs/ bsdu ba bzhi'i sgo nas ji ltar 'os 'os su/

skye dgu rnams skyong ba'i snyan grags kyi rol mos phyogs bcur khyab par mdzad de bzhugs pa las/| yum drung nyid kyang sde srid kyi thugs khur phul nas/ thugs dam nyams len la thugs rtse gcig tu gzhol bar bzhed nas/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang yang rje nyid la zhu ba phul bas/ rje nyid kyi thugs bskyed rgya chen po'i sgo nas/ yum gyi thugs bzhed ji ltar yod pa bzhin bsgrubs par mdzad nas/ 'bri gung pa'i khyad nor ming chen rnams ma gtogs pa'i gzhan longs spyod kyi dngos po gang dgos dang*/ lung chen gsum g.yog rigs dang bcas pa gnang nas/ thugs mnyes par mdzad de/ klung shod rtse ba'i gzhis khar thugs dam zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ rten bzhengs la sogs pa gang mdzad kyi dgongs pa rje nyid kyi bsgrubs pa yin no// 'bri gung pa'i chos 'jig rten gyi thugs khur chen po bsnams pa'i gzhi rten yang*/ phyogs phyogs nas dad pas ji ltar phul ba de tsam gyis thugs chog shes par mdzad de/| bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa'i thugs stobs bskyed pas/ rim gyis rim gyis je mtho je mthor gyur te/ longs spyod rnams kyang zad pa med pa nam mkha'i mdzod lta bur gyur pa yin no// de nas 'bri gung pas sde srid rin po che'i 'jig rten gyi thugs khur thams cad rje nyid kyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras rigs rus sogs yon tan du mas phyug pa mkhyen pa'i blo gros la thogs pa med pa'i skyes mchog dbon po mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bas bsnams nas/| gling 'di'i mchod rten rnams kyi zhig gsos/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i gyang hrul du song ba rnams legs par gsos/ zhal zhal kyang legs par bsgrubs nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa la slob pa'i tshul gyis skye dgu rnams kyi mig rgyan du mdzad par bzhed nas/

zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa 'bri gung gi gling rin po che'i bkod pa gzigs par bzhed pa dang mtshungs ldan du spyan 'dren zhus te/ rje nyid dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes pa/ sa mo phag gi lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la phebs pa'o// de'i tshe rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid/ der bzhugs kyi bla ma che bgres sogs sku'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor te/ gzhu stod rdzan thang gi gnas su bsdu ba mdzad nas mjal 'phrad mdzad de/ de nas mchod pa'i bye brag gis bsu ba'i tshul ni/| gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dar cha'i tshogs dang*/ rnga dang dung dang sil snyan la sogs pa rol cha'i tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ spos phor thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyis ser sbrengs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ lus bzang mdzes pa'i khye'u dang bu mo'i tshogs kyi glu gar la sogs pa mchod sprin rgya chen pos spyan drangs nas/| mtshe'u kha'i gzims khang du phebs te/ phan tshun seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas/ gsung gis bdud rtsis 'gro ba rnams smin par mdzad cing*/ ro brgya ldan pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la rol bar mdzad ba'o// tshur la yang 'bri gung rin po che'i drung du/ gnang skyes rim pa yang rgya hor nas byung ba'i khyad nor gyi gtsos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mthil du rten gsum rnams mjal bar phebs nas/ so so la snyan dar/ na bza' sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dge 'dun tshogs pa chen po la yang*/ mang skol dang gser 'gyed sogs gya nom pa dang*/ thog kha gser khang du gnas 'brel mdzad pa'i nub mo/ sngar las khyad par du gyur pa'i sku khams dwangs shing thugs dam gyi bogs thon pa byung ba dang*/ de'i nub mo 'jig rten gsum mgon mjal zhing*/| gsung gi snang ba yang bstan nas/ gser khang chos rje'i thugs khar thim pa gzigs nas/ gdung shugs drag pos bstod pa'i phreng ba de yang mdzad nas/

der 'dus thams cad la 'bri gung 'di rdo rje gdan dang khyad par mi 'dug cing*/ gser khang chos rje'i sku 'di yang 'jig rten mgon po dngos dang yin par 'dug byin rlabs kyi babs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug gsungs so// de nas rje spyan snga de nyid/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar spyan 'dren zhus pa'i steng du mkhan slob chos gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi 'bul snod kyang rgya chen pos mnyes par mdzad/ bla g.yel chen mo ru/ seng ge'i khri la bzhugs par gsol ba btab nas/| gsung gi bdud rtsis dge 'dun gyi tshogs thams cad smin cing grol bar mdzad do// so so nas kyang zhabs tog dang zhabs rim bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos thugs mnyes par mdzad do// de nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang*/ skye dgu rnams bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir/ yun ring du bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab pas bka'i gnang ste/ stan phab nas bzhugs par mdzad do// de'i tshe rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus pa'i bdag por gyur kyang*/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni// zang zing med par chos ston dang*// zhes pa'i don dang mthun par gdul bya'i slob ma rnams blo nges su gzhug pa'i phyir/ gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni thog mar mgon po tshe dpag med dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i lugs kyi dbang dang sgrub dkyil man ngag dang bcas pa gsan pa dang*/ de nas rgyud thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po chen po'i dbang dang 'khor lo sdom pa lu dril gyi skor/| smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa'i phyag len rnams gsan nas thugs dam 'chag med mdzad pa dang*/ de rjes rje phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs par gsan pa'i brgyud pa'i bka' bab gnang nas smon lam tshigs bcad kyang mdzad do// gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi snying po/

rgyud sde rin po che'i yig sna/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi za ma tog zhal 'byed par mdzad nas/ gsang sngags rgyud 'bum du grags pa de rnams kyis lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa la ma gsan pa'am/ mi mkhyen pa dang mngon sum du ma mdzad pa gang yang med pa/ spyan snga rin po che'i thugs la yang ngo mtshar ba'i me tog gsar pa 'khrungs nas yang nas yang du bstod pa'i gsung gis dgyes pa chen po bskyed nas/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing*/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i bka' gros zab mo dang*/ khyad par bde chen yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ de'i khang phran dang bcas pa sogs/ bshad sgrub kyi dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa'i bya ba mthar 'don pa'i bka' gros rnams kyang thugs thag chod par mdzad nas zhabs tog dang*/ 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na dpe zla dang bral bar mdzad/ drung 'khor rnams la yang gang 'os kyi yid kyi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad/ phar la 'byon dus skyel thung la ti sgro'i bar du phebs nas/ phan tshun phyag dang phyag lan mdzad nas/ ngo mtshar ba'i bka' lung zab mos 'gro ba rnams thugs yid 'dres pa'i ngang nas mdzad pa'i tshe/ dri bzang gi ngad pa dang*/ me tog gi char la sogs pa byung ba la/ skye bo rnams rjes su yi rang ba skyes thar pa'i sa bon skrun pa yin no// de dag gi don smras pa/ e ma sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig gcig po// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun dga' rin chen 'dis// yongs 'dzin bla ma re re'i spyan snga ru// zab chos man ngag re re'i phyir du yang*// lus srog rdul du rlog pa'i snying rus dang*// dad gus brtson 'grus drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis// longs spyod ma lus gtong ba'i thugs stobs 'di// 'phags pa rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang la'ang*// yod pa min no skal ldan skyes bu rnams// de phyir dad gus bskyed la gsol ba thob/| /|bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du// rje btsun mchog 'dis rjes su 'dzin gyur cig

/ces pa yang rje nyid kyi mdzad pa la dad cing mos pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// slar yang 'bri gung mthil du phebs nas/ sku mtshams bcad rgya dam par mdzad de thugs dam rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las g.yo ba med par bzhugs so// de nas skabs shig la sgom chen rnams kyis zhus nas/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma byin rlabs kyi bang mdzod mdzad de/ rim gyis dbyar chos sogs gsung chos rnams dus las ma yol bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi dad 'dus sogs la/ rang rang gi 'dod chos dang ngo sprod gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas gnang bar mdzad cing dman pa rnams la brnyas pa dang khyad gsod mi mdzad/ chen po rnams la ngo dga' dang che bstod med par/ thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rlabs po che dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad cing*/| thugs dam zab mo'i rim pas dus 'da' bar bzhugs so// de nas kun ldan lcags pho byi ba'i lo la thugs nges 'byung dang skyo shas drag po'i gsung mang po 'byon zhing*/| da lo'i lo 'di nged rang 'bri gung pa 'di chag sgo che bar 'dug ces gsungs shing*/ sku rim thugs dam la lhod pa med par mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams la yang so sor bka' bkod kyis khyab par gnang nas/ zla ba lnga pa la dbyar chos gnang zhing*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis la bdud kyi las g.yos te/ chos rje dbang rin po che zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan no// de'i gtam gsan ma thag gsol 'debs dad pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di mdzad do// kye ma yab gcig chos kyi rje// mgon med bdag cag bor nas ni// snying rje'i zla ba gang du bzhud// mtshan nas 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i me dong du// bsregs pa'i sdug bsngal 'o dod can// nyam thag mi skyob 'di ci zhig /mtshan nas 'bod do thugs rjes bzung*// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol ba'i gru chen zhig pa la/| /|nyam nga'i mtsho 'di ji ltar sgrol// 'gro ba sgrol cig rje btsun mgon// 'on kyang khyed la gshegs bzhud med// bdag gi rtag 'dzin zlog pa'i phyir// rnam 'phrul bstan pa kho nar nges// 'khrul snang zlog cig gu ru rje// zhes pa la sogs pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba mang du 'debs pa mdzad cing*/

de ga'i 'phral du mkhar thog gzhis khar phebs nas/ zhal ngo thams cad la bka' bkod kyi khyab par mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs kyi cha rkyen dang thugs khur gyi gzhi thams cad rin po che dpon slob kyis bzung*/ zhal ngo byings kyis zur nas khyog te/ yab mes kyi gab srol bzang po'i lugs bzhin du/ thog mar dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu bsdu bar mdzad de/ mdo rgyud kyi zab don gnas lugs kyi nyams len zung 'jug rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par 'jog par gsol ba'i ngang nas/| rang rang gi gzhung lugs dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu ni legs par bkod/ zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur bzang zhing gya nom pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i 'byor pa lta bu bshams shing*/ dbus gtsang du grags che ba'i rten gsum rnams la yang*/ zhal zas mar me snyan dar spos kyi bye brag la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po dang*/ dgon pa rnams la yang mang skol 'gyed chen/ bla ma che dgu rnams la yang 'bul snod kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams bkram zhing*/ phyogs 'dir skye bo'i tshogs rnams la'ang 'dod yon gyi char chen po phab ste/ longs spyod kyi dbul ba dang bral bar mdzad nas nang rten thub pa'i dbang po'i sku phyag tshad legs par grub ste/ sgo mang gi mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i bar gyi dgongs rdzogs thams cad rin po che nyid kyis mthar 'don par mdzad pa yin no// chos rje dbang rin po che de nyid zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su'ang*/ 'phral bya btang gi tshul bzung nas/ 'gro ba la bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i snying rje chen po'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin cing skyong ba dang*/ thugs dam nyams len gyi rim pa yang mdo rgyud kyi man ngag mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab par rgyas shing*/ grub rtags kyi mtshan ma yang mngon sum du ston nus pa zhig yin zhing*/

sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi dus thams cad du/ me tog sngon po'i char chen pos sa'i khyon thams cad gang zhing rten ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa yin no// nang rten gyi gser sku la me tog mthor dus su/ char shin tu dkon pa'i dus yin pa la/ char chen po bab pas thub pa char 'bebs ma zhes grags zhing*/ phyis kyang char dkon pa'i dus/ sku khrus gsol zhing char 'beb pa'i gsol ba btab na/ rtsol med du char 'bab pa'i byin rlabs can du grags so// rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyis yongs 'dzin gyi bla ma dam pa rnams la/ ngo lkog dang zhal gting med par thams cad la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes las tha mal gyi rnam pa skad cig kyang mi mnga' zhing*/| khyad par chos kyi rje dbang rin po che de nyid la/ bka' drin che ba sems ngo sprad pa'i bla ma gsum gyi nang nas kyang*/ sa gsum na 'gran zla bral ba'i 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i pha chos zab mo/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus pa'i snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa'i gdams pa khyad par can rnams/ nor bdag po la sprod pa'i tshul gyis gnang ba sogs bka' drin la 'khor ba med pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mthar thug pa chos kyi sku'i mos gus dang ma bral bar mdzad pa yin no// de ltar yin pas/ zhal bzhugs dus na zhabs tog mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan tshe dgongs rdzogs rjes su rje de nyid kyi gsung gi bstan pa spel ba la brtson pa mi lhod par bzhugs pa'o// des na mnyam med rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid/ 'gyur ba med pa'i mos gus kyi gting zab cing*/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i don thams cad mthar phyin du 'grub pa la dbang sgyur ba yin pas/ yum drung rgyal mo ba'i drung la yang ji srid zhal bzhugs kyi bar du bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang*/

sku gshegs pa'i tshe dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad yid tshim par mdzad do// de nas sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdu ba bzhi la brten nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang tshul mthun par/ tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho rnam par spel ba'i phyir zad pa med pa'i longs spyod la dbang bsgyur bar bzhed pa'i tshul bstan nas/ gnod sbyin ye shes kyi mgon po la bka' bsgo mdzad pas/| bka' nyan gyi 'phrin las tshul bzhin du bsgrub par dang du blangs pa/ de ga'i lo la longs spyod rnams rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin 'dus par gyur te/ lo de'i nang du yang*/ rgya nag mnga' ris/ bal bod khams la sogs pa nas che dgu dang btsun dgu skal pa dang ldan pa rnams dal 'byor don dang ldan zhing*/ longs spyod la snying po len pa'i phyir/ phyogs phyogs nas ser sna'i bsam blo dang bral shing*/ rje 'di nyid kyi phyag tu ci thengs la 'gran pa bzhin gyur te/ bya bral gyi tshul can re res yang*/| gser zho brgya phrag du ma dang*/ dngul zho stong phrag du ma sogs 'bul ba la bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de ltar dad 'dus kyis phul ba'i longs spyod kyi dngos po/| chung ngu tsam yang chud zos dang rang don du spyod par mi mdzad cing*/ chos phyogs su gtong ba la/ phangs pa'i rnam pa tsam yang mi mdzad par dga' ba dang spro ba chen po'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa las mi 'da' bar 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad pa ni rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'o// de ltar chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod la snying po len tshul yang*/ lo re re bzhin bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod chen mo rnams dus las ma yol bar/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur rgya chen po dang*/ rten gsum rnams kyi drung du snyan dar mar me rgya spos sogs kyi mchod pa/

kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i mchod sprin ltar legs par bkod/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong gi rim pas 'jig rten gyi dbul ba sel bar mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang dbyar dgun gyi cha la/ dge 'dun grangs mang po dang ldan pas/ sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sogs te/ 'bum brgya tshar du ma dang*/ bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar lnga re dang*/ bstan 'gyur tshar re sgrog par mdzad pa dang*/ ye shes mgon po sogs gsar rnying gi rkang gi rgyun 'dzin pa bcu las mi nyung ba dang*/ gsung rab kyi rgyun nyin mtshan thun dgos nas 'dzin pa grangs ldan du ma dang*/ dpyid dus tsha tsha'i rim pa 'bum ther dang*/ mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mdos chen gyi rim pa du ma dang*/ sgrub sde dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i lo gsum phyogs gsum pa'i sku mtshams pa grangs mang la 'tsho ba'i sgrub rgyags kyi spyan dang 'chad nyan la bskos pa'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ dbyar chos dgun chos sogs kyi chos nyan phal che ba'i cha rkyen rnams bla brang nas sbyor bar mdzad kyang*/| de rnams la ngal ba dang dub pa mi mnga' zhing*/ longs spyod rnams phangs pa med par btang nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir zhal bkod kyi khyab par mdzad de/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa lags so// 'di ltar bdag cag gi bla ma khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i sprul pa/ skye dgu thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag po las skyob par byed pa'i mkhyen brtse dang nus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa 'dis/ tshogs gnyis rin po che'i chu gter gy-i ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bzung nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ skyabs dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir thugs bskyed rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te thog mar bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/

rgyu bzang la 'bru dag par bzhengs pa'i thugs 'dun shar tshul ni 'di lta ste/ rje btsun chen po kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid la stod smad bar gsum gyi phyogs thams cad nas/ lus dang srog la ma ltas par/ rje btsun 'di kho na la gtad nas yongs te/ dad pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas phul ba'i longs spyod rnams chud mi za zhing*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas lo paṇa skyes mchog rgyal blon byang sems/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la sogs te bka' drin la 'khor ba med pa'i dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gsob pa'i phyir dang*/ mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i skyabs gnas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir du/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i thugs 'dun drag po shar te/ rje btsun nyid kyi bka' thams cad gus pas spyi bor len cing*/ rnam dkar dge ba'i phyogs la ser sna'i sgrib pa dang bral ba'i blo stobs dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo/ drag po'i brtul zhugs kyi phas rgol 'joms pa dang*/ rang srid skyong ba la mkhas pa'i mi dbang chen po mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ rje btsun nyid kyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar yod tshul dang bcas pa'i bka' phebs pas/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan de nyid kyis rje la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ mdzes pa'i bzhin la 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'phro ba'i ngang nas dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po skyes te/ rje btsun nyid kyi dgongs pa la ji ltar yod pa ltar skyo ba dang sun pa med par sgrub par bya'o zhes khas blangs nas/ dpal mi'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pas/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus rgya chen po'i sgo nas ngal ba dang dub pa med par/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i tshul gyi thugs dam bka' 'gyur rin po che grub pa'o// da ni ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/

de yang gnas phun sum tshogs pa mi mjed zhing gi thig le/ shing 'dzam bu tri shas mtshan pa'i gling gi snying po 'am/ mchog tu gyur pa dpal rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i ru bzhi'i cha/ byang phyogs dbu ru'i dben gnas dam pa/| rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis lung bstan zhing*/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po la sogs pa/ grub pa thob pa'i skyes chen du mas/| byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rlabs chen g.yo ba'i rdo rje gdan gnyis pa/ mkhas shing grub ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin grol kyi lam la bkod pa'i chos kyi pho brang chen po/ bsgoms pa tsam gyis rig pa mchog tu dwangs shing*/| ma bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyi skye ba'i gnas mchog 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling gi ya gyal/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen gyi gzhal med khang chen por/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi brjod bya/ bslab gsum rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa ma nor bar tshul bzhin du ston pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid/ lug lo'i ston dus smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la/ rig byed yi ge'i 'du byed sgyur ba la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa bzhi brgya'i tshogs kyis mthing shog gi ngos la rin po che'i 'bur du dod par 'khod pa'i tog dkar mkhan po/ rnam dpyod kyi blo gros dang ldan pa du ma dang*/| yi ge'i sdeb sbyor phul du phyin pa'i dag byed mkhas pa'i zhus dag mkhan po dang*/ glegs shing glegs thag na bza'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rang rang gi bzo la sbyangs pa phul tu phyin pa rnams kyi legs par bsgrubs te/ tshes grangs dang gza' skar 'dzoms pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ rje btsun rgyal ba'i dbang pos gtso bo mdzad pa'i bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan zhing*/

rim gnyis zab mo'i don la dbang bsgyur ba'i bshes gnyen/ gsang sngags cho ga'i lag len la mkhas pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag du mas rab gnas mnga' dbul shis brjod la sogs te/ me tog 'thor bar mdzad do// de ltar rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/| nam mkha'i khams thams cad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang*/ lha'i bu dang bu mos gang ste/ 'ja' 'od kyis bar snang thams cad mdzes par byas shing*/ me tog gi char lding zhing babs pas sa gzhi'i ngos thams cad khebs par gyur to// mchod pa'i khyad par ni/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/| dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ lha dang mi'i mchod pas sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar byas pa'o// yon gyi khyad par gyi rnam grangs ni/ gos dar sna lnga'i yug gis bar snang gang ba dang*/ gyi ling rta mchog dang*/ stobs ldan gyi glang po la sogs te rkang bzhi'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi thams cad khyab par byas shing*/ gzhan yang bcud kyis gang ba'i gan dkar dang*/ gser g.yu dang go khrab dang*/ ja sig dang snam phrug la sogs te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i dbang po'i dpal 'byor la 'gran pa ltar spungs te/| so so'i 'dod pa tshim par byas so// rig byed mkhan po yi ge'i 'du byed sgyur ba rnams kyang*/ dga' ba dang spro ba dpag tu med pa'i yid thob nas/ dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs dpag tu med pa'i ngang nas/ nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par rje 'di nyid kyi che ba'i yon tan 'ba' zhig brjod pa la brtson zhing*/ mi brjed pa'i dad pa thob ste 'di phyi'i don kun grub par gyur to// de ltar legs par bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che 'di'i phyir du longs spyod kyi rgyu dngos song ba/ lus po bskol ba/| zhal bkod do dam byas pa/ tha ma yang*/

chu len thal 'phyag la sogs te mdor na 'di'i phyir du gom pa dor ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang bgyis pa thams cad ngan song gi 'jigs pa las myur bar grol nas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi 'bras bu thob pa la the tshom med pas/ dal 'byor don yod par byas shing longs spyod rnams kyi snying po lon pa yin no// de lta bu'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ brtson 'grus tshad med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che 'phral 'phral nyid du grub par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa ni mthar phyin/ 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du bshad sgrub kyi snying po len pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa ni yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho bzhin du dar zhing rgyas te brgya phrag re re dang gnyis gnyis kyis gang ba dang bri ba ni mi mngon/ so so'i yongs 'dzin chen po rnams kyis phyogs mtha' dag tu dge 'dun gyi bya ba'i 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis dus 'da' bar byed pa'i dgongs pa ni sgrub/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas deng sang gi bar du/ bye brag gi gdul byar gyur pa 'dan yul sogs nas rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing*/ yon tan du ma'i khur gyis lji ba'i bshes gnyen chen po puṇ+ya sa mu dras thog drangs khams skyo'i bla ma chen po khu dbon rnams dang*/ bkra shis sgang ba'i bla ma chen po khu dbon dang*/ 'ja' mo dbon po dang bcas pa'i che dgu rnams kyis phrin las kyi rtsa ba bzung ste/ 'bul dpon rnams la rim pa bzhin du/ rta dang dre'u dang gser dngul la sogs pa longs spyod rnams kyi 'bul ba rgyun mi 'chad cing*/ khyad par rgya nag nas gong ma rgyal po'i 'bul cha rnams kyang je bzang je bzang du gyur cing*/ 'bul dpon rnams kyis kyang ji lta ba bzhin phyag tu 'byor/

mnga' ris skor gsum nas kyang*/ gu ge'i rgyal po sogs so so'i sa skyong gi rgyal po che chung*/ dgon sde'i bla ma grwa bu slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang so so nas 'bul ba'i bye brag grangs las 'das pa rnams dang*/ dbus gtsang gi che dgu phal cher gyis rje btsun 'di'i zhabs pad la/ spyi gtsug gi nor bus gtugs te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na 'gran zla dang bral zhing rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu gyur pas/ de dag gi phul ba'i longs spyod rnams chud mi za ba dang*/ 'gro kun rnam grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa gsal bar ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub tshad ldan rnams kyi mdzad pa/ lo paṇa chen po rnams kyis ji ltar bsgyur ba'i gsung rab bstan 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid/ rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa'i gru bo che la brten nas/ 'gro kun thar pa'i gling du bgrod par mdzad pa'i ded dpon nam/ shes bya'i gnas thams cad mngon sum du blta bar byed pa'i mig dang mtshungs par gzigs nas/ 'di dag 'bru dag pa glegs bam dkar po'i phreng bar spel ba/ sngon chad bod 'dir mang zhig byung 'dug na'ang*/ glegs bam sngon po'i ngos la/ rin po che'i yig 'brus bkod pa mi 'dug pas/| nyid kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la sngon chad ma byung ba'i bkur sti chen pos mnyes par bya ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ mtha' yas pa'i skye dgu'i 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chen po las skyob pa'i slad du/ rgyu rin po che las grub pa'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum gtos che ba dang bcas pa/ glegs bam sngon po'i phreng ba bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'di spel bar bzhed nas/ thog mar ma phyi 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur las zhus shing*/

cung zad kha 'thor/ lañja 'ba' 'bru rnams legs par bsdus te tshang bar mdzad nas/ sde tshan so so'i bzhugs tshul go rim rnams mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyi bzhed pa'i dkar chag gzhir bzhag ste/ 'phan yul dang zhogs su skyes pa'i rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi bris mkhan mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams bsdus te/ gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa la/ dbu 'dzugs par mdzad de/ lo bzhi'i nang du grub cing*/ gsung rab kyi don la legs par sbyangs shing*/ sgra dang tshad ma'i dpal 'byor du mas phyug pa/ 'bri gung byang chub gling na bzhugs pa'i skyes bu chen po du mas zhus cing dag par mdzad do// sngar gyi ma phyi'i po ti gnyis gnyis dril ba'i po ti brgya dang brgyad du legs par bsgrigs nas bzhugs so// gsung rab rin po che 'di nyid yongs su sgrub pa'i phyir/ byi lo'i cho 'phrul rta'i zla ba la/ snyug gu 'dzugs par brtsams pa'i dus kyi tshe/ sa phyogs 'di'i sa chu thams cad dros te/ dbyar kyi dus bzhin du gyur nas ri dang klungs kyi rtswa thams cad sngo zhing*/ shing gi lo 'dab thams cad kyang rgyas pa dang*/ me tog thams cad kyang 'bus te/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung ba la/ yi ge'i 'du byed sgyur ba'i rig byed mkhan po rnams bden brdzun gyi the tshom du gyur nas/ legs par brtags pas bden pa'i nges pa rnyed pa'i tshe/| rje nyid la dad pa dang mos pa'i rtsa ba tshugs nas nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par brtson 'grus kyi go cha bgos te ring por ma thogs par legs par grub pa yin no// de nas gza' skar dus bzang 'dzoms pa la/ sngags 'chang grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen du ma dang bcas te/ rje btsun nyid kyi rab tu gnas pa rgya chen po mdzad de/| glegs shing glegs thag na bza'i tshogs dang bcas te rin po che'i khri la bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa rgya chen po rgyun mi 'chad par bzhugs pa'o// de ltar legs par grub pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul ni/

rje btsun kun dga'i nyi ma gral gyi dbu la bzhugs te/ yon tan khur gyi lci ba'i che bgres kyis thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi g.yas gral mdzad/ rig byed mkhas pa'i rgyal po tog dkar bas thog drangs/ bris mkhan rnams kyi g.yon gral mdzad de/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zas sna brgya phrag du mas bkur sti'i khri la blangs te yon gyis khyad par ni/ bar snang thams cad gos dar gyis gang ba dang*/ sa gzhi'i ngos thams cad gser g.yu dang*/ dngul zangs dang*/ go khrab dang*/ rta dang nor gyis bkang ba la sogs te dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas shin tu tshim par byas te/| bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i dus kyi tshe/ me tog gi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can gyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang ba'i tshe/ rig byed mkhan po rnams ni/ ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long g.yos te/ 'di rmi lam yin nam/ mngon sum yin/ rmi lam yin na gnyid ma sad na dga' ba la zer zhing*/ dad pa dang gus pa rgya chen po'i sgo nas/ zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ gang yod kyi longs spyod kyi thog nas/ 'bul bas mnyes par byas nas/| rang rang gi gnas su phyin te rje nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par gyur pa yin no// gsung rab 'di'i phyir du rgyu dngos tshul cung zad tsam smos na/ gan gos rgyu bzang la kha dog mdzes pa brgya phrag du ma dang*/ gser dngul zho grangs stong phrag du ma dang*/ dkar spyad la sogs pa khyad nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ rta mchog bzang po dang dre'u stobs ldan bzhi brgya'i tshogs dang*/ mdzo dang mdzo mo'i tshogs la sogs ste rkang 'gro grangs las 'das pa dang*/ dkar spyad la sogs pa khyad nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ rta mchog bzang po dang dre'u stobs ldan bzhi brgya'i tshogs dang*/ mdzo dang mdzo mo'i tshogs la sogs te rkang 'gro grangs las 'das pa dang*/| gzhan yang ja sig dang go khrab dang*/

dos mgo la sogs te re re'i ming nas brjod par mi nus so// 'di thams cad kyi zhal ta bkod pa'i khyad par dang*/ thugs khur thams cad mthil du blangs nas zhabs 'bring bsgrub par byed pa'i skyes bu ni/ sngon rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phyir bos pa'i mgron bzhir grags pa'i ya gyal/ rwa sgreng mthu chen zhes bya ba'i gdung rigs/ sngon nas smon lam dpag tu med pas mtshams sbyar ba las byung ba'i rje nyid kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i blo gros mchog dang ldan pa/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas gus pa'i bsam sbyor dang ldan pas bsgrubs pa'o// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bstan 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa'i gnas ni rgyal bas bsngags pa'i 'dzam gling rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa/ drang srong 'phags pa bsam gtan sgom pa'i dben gnas/ sgo mang gser gyi mchod sdong 'gyings pa'i zhol khang*/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang pos/ rgyun du chos 'khor rim par bskor ba'i gnas chen/ dad 'dus kyi skal ldan rnams 'du ba'i zhing mchog legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i pho brang*/ ljon shing dang*/ me tog dang*/ ne'u sngon pos mdzes par brgyan pa'i steng*/ lha phrug gzhon nu'i tshogs kyi me tog 'thor ba'i zhing sa mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen du/ rje btsun nyid kyi sngon du bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang*/ thugs dam rten gsum ngo mtshar mang po grub pa'ang bzhugs pa dang*/ khyad par phyogs 'dir sngon chad ma byung ba'i gsung rab rgyu rin po che las bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur rin po che 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur pa 'di rnams/ phyogs bcu'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu ma lus pa zhing 'dir bsdus te/

gcig tu spungs pa bzhin du gyur te/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i zhing du/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te bzhugs pa yin no// de ltar dka' ba dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bsgrubs pa'i bstan 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid kyi phyir/ rgyu lus bkol ba dang*/ zas nor longs spyod kyi 'brel pa thogs pa la sogs te/ mdor na mthong thos dran reg yi rang bgyis pa yan chad/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa chen po las sgrol te/ thar pa'i lam sna zin par the tshom med par 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad pa 'di yang*/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi thugs rje tshad med pa'i stobs kyis 'brel tshad tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi lam la bkod pa'i rnam par thar pa'o// de ltar sngon chad bzhengs pa'i gsung rab rnams las khyad par du gyur pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen grub thob tshad ldan rnams kyis/ rgyal ba'i bka' snga phyi bar gsum gyi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rgyu rin po che las grub pa glegs bam sngon po'i phreng bar spel ba la nag phyogs bdud kyi bar chad kyi lhongs tshad dpag tu med pa g.yos te/ dus 'khrugs chen po langs nas 'gal rkyen gyi rnam pa ci byung yang*/ rje btsun nyid kyis bdud tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste/| gsung rab kyi mthar 'don mdzad pas/ bar chad bdud kyi dgra las rgyal te/ bstan 'gyur rin po che mthar phyin du grub pa la/ rang gzhan thams cad ya mtshan du gyur nas/ rje btsun rgyal dbang 'di nyid la/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad mchod cing bstod par byed pa yin no// de dag gi don 'dir smras pa/ thar 'dod yongs kyi bla med mgon gcig po// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa 'di nyid kyis// dad brtson ldan pa'i skal ldan gdul bya la// gang 'dul gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad// 'dod chags can rnams tshul khrims lam la bkod// zhe sdang can rnams nus pas zil gyis gnan// gti mug can rnams ma rig gnyid las bslangs// nga rgyal can rnams dregs pa'i ri bo bsnyil// phrag dog can rnams mnyam nyid don la bkod// ser sna can rnams sbyin pa'i gter dang sprad// rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa'i thugs rje yis// 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i mdzad pa la// ngo mtshar mos pas kun la rjes yi rang*// tshe 'dir byang chub sgrub pa'i skyes bu rnams// 'brel tshad don ldan 'di la gsol ba thob// thar pa'i lam sna zin par the tshom med// ces pa 'di yang*/

rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu la mos pas/ rjes su yi rang bas tshigs su bcad pa'o// rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur la sogs te/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa la sogs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyi mdzad pa bdun pa mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis bstan dgra ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad de bdud dpung gi g.yul las rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa ni/| bar skabs zhig nas skye dgu rnams skal ba dman pa'i dbang gis rgyal khams su 'khrugs pa chen po langs pa'i gzhi rkyen ni/ yar klungs sne gdong pa dang rin spungs pa ma 'dum pa'i dbang gis byi ba'i lo la sde gzar chen po langs pas skye bo mang po dag sdug bsngal bar byas te/ de'i dus sne gdong pa cung zad spangs mtho ba ltar snang ba'i thugs rgyal gyi snyems pas/ rgyal khams thams cad mnga' 'bangs su bcug pa dang*/ khyad par 'bri gdan gyi dam tshig gnyan po la yang 'gom nas thub tshod chen pos nyes pa yod med kyi brtag gzhig med par/ 'bri gung pa'i sde la 'phral du tsha rngam chen pos dpung gi tshogs 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba bkod nas 'jun sdur la zhugs so// de'i tshe yang*/ rin po che 'di nyid thugs 'khrugs pa med cing*/ cung zad brtag gzhig gi lam la 'jug pa'i dgongs pas/| rang gi mnga' 'og gang yod kyi rang srung tsam du bsdu bar mdzad de/ dbu ru ka tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du phebs nas/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas 'bri gdan 'brel chags tshul nas/ da lta yang nyes pa'i zhad med pa'i rnam bzhag rnams gsung drang po'i gnang ba bstan nas/

brda legs par 'byor bar byas kyang*/ da res kyi dpung 'gyes bde ba tsam las gzhan pa'i brtsi bzhag med par byas so// de'i dus su snga thun grol nas nyi ma phyed la nye ba na/ ka tshal gtsug lag khang gi nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ phyag stong spyan stong gi sku shin tu gsal ba gcig zhal gzigs byung bas/ gsol ba btab te dngos grub blangs so// de nas bzung ste/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa thugs la 'khrungs so// de nas rje btsun rin po che slar yang mtshe'u khar phebs nas/| dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ngang nas/ rig byed pa rnams bsdus nas thugs dam bstan 'gyur rin po che mthar 'don pa'i dgongs pa mdzad do// de'i dus su yar klungs pa'i gser yig pa rnams kyi mi rigs pa'i gtam mang po btang ba/ nged rang gi drung 'khor rnams kyi thos pas/ zhe sdang te gser yig pa gsod pa'i gros byas pa rje nyid kyis gsan te/ thugs brtse ba chen pos mi 'jigs pa'i snang ba gnang nas rang gnas su bde bar phyin par mdzad do/| /|de ga'i 'phral du snyug gu btsugs pas/ blo chung rnams ni/ sne gdong pa'i gser yig pa'i rgyab/ dmag dpung gi mnan nas yong rgyur 'dug pas/ chos rje'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur rang ci 'dra yong zhes ma rangs pa'i tshul gyis gleng ba la/ rje nyid 'od gsal 'gro 'ong thams cad dang bral ba mnyam nyid chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus shig na/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma/ yum mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i tshul du sprul nas byon byung bas/ 'bri gdan sde 'khrugs chen po byung dus/| bdag cag rnams ni ci ltar 'gyur zhes zhus pas/ blo sna ma mang dang*/ mi skyon no zhes gsung gi gnang ba byung nas thugs brling bar mdzad do// gong du bstan pa ltar mthar phyin nas/ dpon yig rnams rang gnas su phyin pa'i skabs su/

sne gdong pa'i dpung chen bteg ste/ skyid g.yor 'phan gsum gyi dmag dpon dga' ldan pas byas/ de bzhin du yar lungs lho byang 'ol kha ba dang bcas pa'i dpung chen rnams dang*/ stag lung pa dang stag rtse ba sogs so so nas dpung gi tshogs chen po bshams nas thams cad kyang dregs pa'i khur chen pos non te/ shin tu rngam zhing shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ char mun chen po 'thibs pa ltar nye bar btud par gyur to// dus der rje rin po che nyid ni thugs 'khrugs pa med par byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so// bka' gros la dbang ba rnams kyi thog drangs nas/ nged rang gi dpung gang yod rnams/ dbu ru ka tshal du bsu ba ltar bkod nas/ gung dkar sne gdong pas bzung ba yang de ma thag du blangs nas snying stobs chen pos brgal zhing brnyas thabs kyi blos bsgyings so// de'i 'phral du dga' ldan pa sde rigs dang bcas pas byang grangs nas/ thams cad dpung gi rloms pa chen pos mgo sgyur zhing se gol gtogs te/ go cha sra ba rnams ni rim pa ma 'chol bar bgos shing*/ skya mi dang rkang thang rnams rang rang rgyan dang dar cha rol mo'i bye brag rnams ni bkram/ mtshon cha'i bye brag rnams rngam pa'i 'dug stangs kyis thogs te/ char sprin nag po'i mun bsros pa bzhin du sa'i phyogs thams cad khyab par byas nas/ 'brug sgra drag po dang bcas pa'i ser ba 'bab pa'am/ nags tshal chen po mes tshig pa ltar 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra drag po dang bcas te lhags nas/| gung dkar dang ka tshal gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad 'khor mor bskor ba'i dus der tshu rol gyi dpang rnams nyung yang*/ dpa' zhum par ma gyur pas/ tshan po che'i brtul zhugs drag pos g.yul bsres so// phan tshun g.yul bsres par gyur pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la mtshon cha'i char bab pa dang*/ mda' rdo'i bu yug 'tshub pa dang*/| khrag gi dri mas phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur pa de ga'i mod la/

phyogs mtshams kun rlung dmar drag po langs nas/ sa dang bar snang kha sbyar ba lta bu'i 'thor rlung rab tu gtor bas pha rol dpung tshogs thams cad byer zhing bros par gyur te phal cher g.yul bsres pa de ga'i mod la bsad par gyur nas/ mgo lag bcad pa'i phung po chen po dpag tu med pa spungs so// 'bri gung pa'i dpung gi tshogs la nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par rmas pa tsam yang med par gyur to// de'i zhag gcig gi gong rol tu gyur pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi zhal nas 'di ltar gsungs ste/ bdag gis chos skyong bsgrubs cing skul byas pas/ dam rdzas kyi bdud rtsi khol ba dang*/ rmi ltas kyang shin tu bzang ba dang*/ khyad par dmag dpung gi tshogs dpag tu med pas/ phyogs mtha' dag nas gtsubs nas shin tu dka' ba'i gnas skabs su/ mtshe'u kha'i gzims chung 'phyong rtse nang mar bzhugs pa'i nangs par tho rangs kyi dus bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgron ma de nyid/ chibs pa chu rta sngo nag la bcibs te/ rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu spras pa/ bya rgod kyi slog pa gsol nas/ rab tu rngam pa'i stabs kyis chibs drag tu bskyod te/| mngon sum du mjal zhing*/ 'khor mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'bum gyis bskor nas/ dgra phyogs su byon pa mthong bas/ mi mthun pa thams cad tshar bcad de/ rang re'i bstan pa zla ba gza' las rgyal ba bzhin du 'gyur bar snang yang*/ 'khrul pa'i dmag dpung mang po nyes 'gro bar 'dug pas/ snying re rje snying re rje na ang gsungs shing bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po yang mdzad do// de nas phyogs kyi dmag thams cad dmag byus nyes pa'i sdug bsngal drag po dang bcas te/ so so'i gnas su gyes par gyur pa'o// des na nus pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje rin po che 'di nyid/ slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung gi sprul par lung bstan pa dang*/ khyad par rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pas gter nas bton pa'i u rgyan gyi lung bstan las/

zhang tshan 'khrugs pas dbus gtsang sil bur gtong : mi mthun sde la gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung : snang mdzad mi g.yo rab tu brtan par gnas: de ni 'bri gung spyan mnga' bcu gsum pa: zhes pa'i lung bstan mngon sum du gyur pa yin no// de nas bzung ste lo shas kyi bar la gang du g.yul chen po bsres kyang*/ phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur pa yin no// des na rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi phrin las thams cad bka' srung rnams kyis rtsol med du bsgrubs pa yin te/ rje nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ dpal mnyam med u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi drag po'i gnas ti sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs khang chen mor/ bdag gis gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i tshe sgrub nyams su blangs pas/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gi nyin/ nyams snang lta bu la gu ru rin po che sku mngon sum du mjal te phreng ba'i tshad gcig ston pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags khyad par can byung ngo*// bka' srung rnams kyis phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul la/ zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub pa byang du mi nyag ring mo'i ja pa rnams 'gro dus ja'i slongs mo la 'gro bar 'dod kyang*/ nad sna yod zer ba la skrag par gyur pa las/ nangs par tho rangs kyi dus su/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma chibs bzhon nas/ khams mo'i chas su bstan te/ 'di skad gsungs so// dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba// zhes bsgrags nas byung bas/ 'dod pa thams cad grub cing*/ nad sna rnams kyi gnod pa las grol bar byas so// dbang gi las sgrub pa la mgon khang rnying ma ru/ gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub nyams su blangs pas/ zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa la/ mi dmar po ral pa khams ser gyen du brdzes pa zhig gis/ lcags kyu gcig dang*/ zhags pa gcig dang phreng ba brgya yod pa gcig byin byung bas/ dbang gi las 'grub pa'i rtags su byung ngo*// rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa la/

gong du bkod pa ltar thog kha gser khang nang mar/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa ser 'jam gtso 'khor tshang ma mngon sum du mjal te/ rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rtags yin par nges te/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pas kyang rtags mtshan 'di byung bas/ rnam thar du rgyas pa'i las 'grub par ngos bzung 'dug pas gtan tshigs su byas so// drag po'i phrin las grub tshul ni/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma/ yum mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i tshul du sprul nas lung ston pa dang*/ bye brag tu sde 'khrugs chen po'i dus shin tu dka' ba'i gnas skabs su/ zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ chibs pa chu rta sngo nag la bcibs te/| rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu spras pa/ rngam stabs dang*/ bya rgod kyi slog pa gsol nas/ chibs rab tu bskyod de/ dgra phyogs su byon pa mthong bas mi mthun pa thams cad tshar bcad de/ bstan pa zla ba gza' las rgyal ba bzhin du byas so// zhes pa rnams rje rang nyid kyi gsung las phrin las bzhi grub tshul gsungs pa ni yid ches pa'i khungs su bkod pa'o// gzhan yang dam pa 'dis thugs bskyed dang gtong phod zhal ta bkod pa'i khyad par re res kyang*/ skye dgu thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba'i gzhi chen por gyur par mdzad pa'i tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de glang gi lo la lcam dang*/ stag gi lo la gcen po rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ sku'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bye brag sgrub pa'i cha rkyen rnams phangs pa med par gnang ba dang*/ zhal ta bkod pa'i khyad par gyis so so'i dgongs pa dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ de dag gi don rnams smon lam rgya mtshos spel ba'i phyir/ jo gdan chos lung pa'i mkhan po dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs shing*/ bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos bkur bar mdzad pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ yi ger brir ma langs pa'o// de nas rje btsun nyid dgung lo so brgyad bzhes pa spre'u yi lo la/

sgar chen brag long phyogs la phebs pa'i dus shig na/ nyang po gad pa steng du zhag 'ga' bzhugs pa'i tshe/| shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis/ rje btsun nyid rnal 'byor pa gcig la/ gsung chos gsan gin 'dug pa'i tshe/ de grol nas sku 'khor rnams kyis/ yo byad sogs gsung ba'i bka' lung mi gnang ba ci lags zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas nyams kyi snang ba lta bur 'dug gsungs te/ de'i dus kyi ras pa de ni gu ru rin po che yin par 'dug go// de'i skabs la sang sing sgang pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rnam 'gyur shin tu mang bar byas shing*/ khyad par tshur phebs lam la/ rgya sgo'i steng du/ lham krad gog po mi gtsang ba rnams spungs pa dang*/ ban btsun rnams kyi lam khar rkang pa rkyang ste srid zhu go log byas/ shu sgra dang shugs pa 'debs pa sogs 'gong po'i cha lugs dang*/ rang skad ngan pa smyo ba lta bur bstan no// tshur phebs rjes rje btsun nyid kyi sku 'dra'i 'bag bcos nas/ ling ga'i bsgral chog kho rang tsho'i chos skyong gi lugs su byas pa'i rgyal 'gong gi gtor sgrub sogs gang shes kyi las ngan mang du brtsams so// de ltar gyi rgyu mtshan rje btsun nyid kyi snyan du zar zur 'bul mkhan byung yang las ngan can de rnams la/ thugs brtse ba chen pos sdang ba'i rnam pa tsam yang mi mdzad par las ngan gyi sgrib pa 'dag pa'i thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so// de nas yum drung bdag mo sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la/ gzhis kha rtse bar phebs nas/ dgongs rdzogs sa steng 'di na 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad cing*/ smon lam rgya mtsho'i don la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir/ stag lung chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa'i mtshan can spyan drangs nas/ zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos 'bul snod kyi khyad par rnams kyang bgrang las 'das pa mdzad cing*/ 'bri stag gi sde ris kyang chos bzhin du skyong ba dang*/|

rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bka' lung kyang bgro bar mdzad do// de'i dus rtse ba'i gzhis kha'i phyi logs kyi khang phran zhig tu mtshan mo bzhugs par gnang ba las/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi bka' nyan sgrub pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi/ phrin las kyi dus la bab nas/ nyang po sang sing pa rnams tshar bcad pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun nyid tho rangs kyi cha la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs nas/ rim gyis nyi ma shar ba'i zer gzims mal nyid du phog pa dang*/ dus mnyam par zhal gyi nang nas bya rog gsum thon nas/ sku spang du bsdad ste/ gshog sgro zhal chab kyi 'byar 'dug pa la gcig gis sgro shad byas nas shar phyogs la 'phur song ba'i dus der/ sems can spyi khyab la dmigs pa'i phyogs med kyi snying rje chen po zhig 'khrungs pa dang dus mnyam du/ bya rog gzhan gnyis po yang ma gnang par slar yang zhal du mid par mdzad de/ bde stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so// dus skabs de nyid na sang sing ba'i phyogs su rlung nag shin tu 'tshubs pas gtsug lag khang bsgyel zhing*/ khang pa gzhan mang po'ang zhig sgrub khang gi gyang ris 'jigs byed kyi sku 'dra yang logs bris gog nas 'brub khung du lhung*/ de'i rjes su mi nor phyugs gsum dgra bos bcom pa rnams mngon sum du gyur cing kun la grags pa'o// des na rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid/ spang bya nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas/ 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes chen po'i bdag nyid du 'dus shing shar bas/ phyi rol gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad kyis/ tshur mi tshugs shing*/ phar zil gyis mnan te/ mthar dbang du 'dus pa'o/ /de dag gi don smras pa/ rgya chen tshogs gnyis lus stobs rab rgyas shing*// mdo rgyud zab mo'i g.yu ral khur gyis brjid// lung rigs nyams rtogs spobs pa'i nga ro yis// rgol ngan 'byung po'i klad pa 'gems mdzad pa'i// thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba'i seng ge mchog

/thub dbang gnyis pa kun dga' rin chen 'di// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag por gyur pa'i mthus// bka' srung chos skyong srung ma bran du 'khol// snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bka' bzhin sgrub// bstan dgra mi mthun phyogs rnams thal bar rlog /mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag po khyod nyid tsam// dus ngan snyigs mar gyur pa'i skye bo rnams// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di la gsol ba thob// bar chad bdud las rgyal bar the tshom med// ces pa 'di nyid rje btsun nyid kyi rnam par thar pa 'di la ngo mtshar dad pas rjes su yi rang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ bstan dgra ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad de bdud dpung gi g.yul las rgyal ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// ༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyi mdzad pa brgyad pa/ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pas phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa ni/ de'i skabs der/ bla ma dkar po kun dga' grags pas bsam yas kyi zhig gsos grub la khad pa'i dus yin pa la/ rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid/ yum gyi gshegs rdzongs legs par grub nas/ mtshe'u kha'i gzims khang 'phyong rtser phebs nas/ snga thun dang po la bzhugs pas 'phyong rtse'i nang du/ sngags pa'i cha byad kyi mi zhig phod kha nag po nyis brtsegs gyon pa/ dar dkar po'i phyam rtses stod g.yogs pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dpangs mtho ba/ lan bu sa la drud pa/ phyag tu dar dkar po dang ka pā la bzung ba/ de la 'khor gnyis 'dug pa ni/ ther ma ngur kha'i pan zhu ang rag dang sgom thag gsol ba/ nam thang gi gzan gyon pa dang bcas pa byung nas/| ral cog bshig nas sku drung du phyag lnga phul te/

gtso bos 'di skad ces zhus so// bsam yas zhig gsos grub pa'i dga' ston dang*/ me tog 'thor ba la gdan 'dren rkang btsugs yin pas/ dgongs pa gnang ba'i bka' drin stsal dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ rje'i zhal nas/ kye ho/ de thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ kho bo'i tshe rabs bla ma sprul pa'i skus byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtsug lag ngo mtshar can/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyas sgo thog ma de/ pad+ma bka'i thang yig dang mthun par zhig gsos grub par thos pas dga' spro 'phel/ da lan 'phral du nged kyis mi sleb kyang*/ rab gnas smon lam 'di nas byed pa dang*/ dga' ston dus su mthun rkyen rdzong bas na/ srung ma khyed rnams bstan srung khur chen mdzod/ ces gsungs pas/ yang sngags pa des/ dar dkar po de phyag tu phul/ ka pā la nas kyis bkang ba de yang gzigs su phul nas 'di skad zhus pa/ gal te tha mal skye bo'i snang ngo ru// khyed sku phebs pa'i dgongs pa mi 'tshal na// 'byung ba bzhi yi gnod pas mi tshugs pa'i/| /|ting nge 'dzin gyi rab gnas 'di nas mdzod/ de skad zhus pa dang*/ rje nyid kyi bsam yas kyi rab gnas la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis u rgyan gu ru la sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum/| gling bzhi gling phran mchod bzhi la sogs pa rten dang brten pa'i sku rnams la bstim par mdzad pa dang dus mnyam du/ ka pā la nas/ nas 'bru gtor bas/| khong dpon slob gsum pos kyang nas 'bru gcig kyang ma yar ba byas nas dar phyam gyi mtha' ma la btums te song ngo*// de nas zhag ma 'gyangs par dkar po ba'i 'gro mgon can dpon g.yog bsam yas la phebs dgos pa'i gdan 'dren rkang btsugs la sleb byung ba la/ rab gnas dga' ston gyi yo byad tsho dpung che ba dang ja gos dar sogs kyang gnang ba yin no// 'di lta bu'i mdzad pa yang shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar yin yang*/
