skal ldan 'ga' zhig dang ba skyed pa'i phyir brjod pa yang bla ma mkha' 'gro la bzod par gsol lo// yang yum drung sku gshegs pa'i phyi lo/ bya'i lo la gcung po chos kyi rgyal po/ sku thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs thams cad kyang rje nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams la mang skol/ 'bri gung du ser sogs dang 'gyed chen/ spyan snga zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pas thog drangs dbus gtsang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ji ltar 'os 'os su rnam gzhag mdzad pa rnams bgrang ba las 'das pa'o// de tsam gyi rkyen khur bab kyang thugs ngal ba dang skyo ba'i rnam pa spangs te/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs chos spyod kyi rim pas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing*/ bstan pa'i bya ba kho nas thams cad kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad do// de nas rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid/ dgung lo zhe gsum bzhes pa glang gi lo la/ 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du dad ldan dpag tu med pa la/ zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhugs so// 'di yi gnas skabs su/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi/| gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i rnam thar zhig brjod par bya ba la bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dgyes bzhin du gnang du gsol/ sngon bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i dus na/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i tshems mche ba g.yas pa byon pa sku'i spang du bzhag pa'i skabs su/ lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang*/ klu'i rgyal po sogs kyi dad pa'i rten du zhus pas/ klu'i rgyal po sog ma med la gnang ste/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'bri sgang rten 'chag zhes par dge slong rin chen dpal zhes bya ba/ 'dus pa 'bum phrag bdun gyi dbus su/ nga'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa zhig 'ong ste/ de la phul zhig gsungs/ de ltar lung bstan cing bka' bsgo ba ltar/

skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos mdzad pa rjes su dran te/ mgar dam pa chos sdings pa la/ klu rgyal sog ma med kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems 'bul ba yod pas longs zhig ces pa'i bka' bsgos ste/ grub thob chos sdings pas/ sog zam gyi thang la sgar rgyab ste/ klu'i rgyal po la gtor ma phul bas/ dus de nyid du skad cig la klu'i rgyal pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba g.yas pa dang*/ klu'i nor bu gsum dang bcas nas phul/| mgar dam pas/ rje 'jig rten gsum mgon la phul bas nor bdag po la sprod pa legs/ khyod kyang 'bras bu sngon song zhig yin pas/ da kho bo'i 'dra 'bag cig bzhengs de'i thugs khar bzhugs shig gsungs nas chos sdings su sku 'bag bzhengs nas/ de'i thugs khar bzhugs su phul/ skyob pa'i phyag nas brgya rtsa gnang*/ rjes su hor gyi 'bri gung gling la chags 'jig gi skabs su/ rten de gling rin po che 'dir gdan drangs/ sngo ru thang du phebs thog gsung byon/ kho bo bye ma'i 'og tu re zhig zhog de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems khyer la lho phyogs su bros gsungs pas/ dkon gnyer zla ba zhes pas/ gser sku bye 'dam byas/ tshems khyer nas brag gsum du byon/ gnubs chen po la phul/ rjes su bcu gnyis rin po ches gling 'di'i zhig gsos dang*/ rten gsum che rags dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems jo gnubs rang gi phyag tshags mdzad de/ dngul sku khru gang ba gcig bzhengs pa'i nang du bzhugs par 'dug go/| /|phyis 'bri gung pa'i slob chos ma 'cham pa'i dus/ chos sgo bas dngul sku gdan drangs/ nyang po rgya nang gi gsang do bo shes par song bas/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyi dgongs pa la/ yab mes gong ma rnams kyang thugs rje chung*/ rten gyi gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems de lta bu la bdag 'dzin dang gces spras tsam yang med par/

gang babs su skur bas/ da lta mnga' zhabs sa yul stong par song*/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can rnams bsod nams chung ba'i shugs 'di lta bu/ dgongs pa'i lan grangs mang ba zhig byung ba'i skabs shig tu/ gzims chung 'phyong rtse'i nang du/ tho rangs snga thun la bzhugs pa'i dus/| gar yongs cha med pa'i khye'u dkar po ral pa'i zur phud can zhig byung ste/ sku zur g.yon gyi phyogs nas thal mo sbyar nas/ shākya'i rgyal po'i tshems mche ba g.yas pa gdan 'dren par thugs mos sam zhu ba zhig byung 'dug pa'i dus/ rje btsun nyid kyi dgongs pa la/ 'khrul pa'i nyams snang gcig yin nam/ yang sngon gyi byed pa rgyu mthun gyi rten 'brel dang*/ dkon mchog thugs rje can gyis rjes su bzung ba yang e srid/ dgongs nas khye'u de la/ khyod nang 'dir sngan chad yongs ba'i rigs can min pa 'dra// ji skad zer ba ci yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems gdan 'dren pa la mos pa shin tu che ste/ thabs gang kyang ma rnyed gsungs pas/ khye'u de bzhin 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyungs ste/ bdag gis rgyal dbang khyed kyis dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i ched du/ or ka dge slong gi sems bsgul te zhabs pad myur du gtug par yod/ de la yid tshim pa'i bya dga' thongs shig glang lo 'di'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems gdan 'dren pa yin no// bdag la gtor ma rin chen sna lnga'i rten gnang du gsol/ zer nas skad cig la med par gyur to// nangs par rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ or ka dge slong zer ba phyogs gang na 'dug kyang 'bod mi thong gis/ bka' phebs pas/ de kha'i grabs yong thog/ brag gsum skyabs rje ba'i dbang 'dzin/ dge slong smon lam zer ba dang*/ or ka dge slong gnyis/| rje nyid kyi zhabs drung du sleb pas/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dgas tshim par gnang ste/ glang lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ gza' skar dang dus sbyor bzang bar bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te/

phyag tu phebs te rje nyid kyi sku dang mi ring bar mchod pa bzang po phul te/ zhal nam bzhugs kyi bar la/ phyag dang mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs pa'o// khye'u ral pa'i zur phud can de ni/ klu rgyal sog ma med kyi sprul pa klu rje rgyal ba thod dkar zhes pa yin pa'i lo rgyus sogs zhib du gnang ba yod do// des na sngon thub pa'i dbang pos klu'i rgyal po la bka' bsgo dang bcas nas rang gi tshems 'jig rten gsum mgon la gnang ba/ klu'i rgyal pos grub thob chos sdings pa rgyud de/ rje rin chen dpal zhes pa/ 'jig rten gsum mgon yin pas de'i phyag tu phul/ de rjes tshems 'di gnas gzhan du 'khyar ba'i rnam pa byung ba la/ slar yang klu'i rgyal po de'i sngon gyi rgyal ba'i bka' bsgo dran pa'i tshul gyis/ rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid la phul ba ni/| rje btsun 'di nyid 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos yin par the tshom med par bstan pa yin no// de lta bu'i rten ngo mtshar can 'di nyid/ sa phyogs 'dir phebs phyin nas/| rje nyid kyi phrin las rgyas pa dang*/ lo legs pa dang*/ mi nad phyug nad dkon pa dang*/ chab srid kyang dar zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba la sogs pa dge ba'i mtshan ma dpag tu med pa byung ngo*// rje btsun 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing du gshegs tshul bstan pa'i rjes su/ sku 'dra rin po che gzims mal gser sku 'di'i thugs khar bzhugs nges rang yin pas/ 'bri gung byang chub gling gi rten gyi gtso bo sku 'dra rin po che 'di la bya ba yin no// tshul de dag ni shin tu gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa gser gyi yang zhun lta bu'i rnam par thar pa yi ger bkod pa la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol lo// gzhan yang rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'dis dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyi zhal blta ba dang*/

phyag bya ba dang*/ bsnyen cing bskur ba la ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs rnam par dag pas skye dgu thams cad kyi mig rgyan du mdzad pa'i phyir/ dgung lo zhe lnga pa yos kyi lo la spyan snga rin po che'i drung*/| sku nas kyang byon pa dang*/ yun ring du zhal mjal ba yang ma grub pas thugs phreng te bde chen yangs pa can gyi phyogs su sgar chen 'degs par mdzad pa'i bar lam du stag lung pa'i sku mched khu dbon dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pas/ bsnyen bkur gyi bye brag dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ shul lam la thogs pa med par phebs te/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la/ mjal ba'i zhu 'phrod kyis sbran cing rim par phebs pa la/ dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur chen pos/| ja 'dren dang thab 'dzin stag lung nas nye bar bzung ste rgyun ma chad par mdzad/ khyad par mjal ba'i nyin par rje spyan snga'i dbon po rdor rgyal bas thog drangs bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang bcas pa'i drung 'khor che dgu rnams dang*/ gdan sa mthil pa'i che bgres yon tan gyi khur gyis lci ba mang po dang*/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtse ba'i nang so rin chen rgyal mchog pas thog drangs sne gdong pa'i drung 'khor phal mo ches dmar sgang nas bsu ba dang thab 'dzin mdzad nas/ rim pa ltar phebs pas/| yangs pa can gyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bus ser sbrengs dar cha rol mo'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur cing*/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung nas kyang bsu ba mdzad pa'i sgo nas dpon slob kyang phyag dang phyag len mdzad pa'i mjal 'phrad mdzad nas/ rin po che'i khri la bzhugs shing*/ drung 'khor rnams kyang phan tshun snyan pa'i gsung gi gleng bslangs dang yid rab tu dga' bar gyur/ lha dang mi'i bza' ba dang btung ba'i bye brag dpag tu med pas sems dga' zhing mgu bar byed do// dus der dam pa 'dis/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung du/

brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul/ drung 'khor rnams la yang gya nom pa'i gnang sbyin/ yangs pa can gyi dge 'dun rnams la yang*/ mang skol dang ja gos dar dang*/ rta dang go khrab la sogs pa'i 'gyed sna mang du mdzad pas thams cad thugs dgyes par gyur to// der phyogs kyi skye dgu thams cad gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do// dam pa 'dis spyan snga rin po che'i drung du/ dbang khrid dang man ngag lung gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mtha' thams cad chod par gsan pa'o// de ltar dam pa rnam gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te nyi ma re re bzhin yang bzhugs gdan mnyam por mdzad cing*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung rab zab mo'i don gyi bgro ba rgya chen po 'phral 'phral la thugs thag chod par mdzad/ gzhi de nyid du gzhis kha rin spungs pa'i ja 'dren 'bul snod kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ phyogs der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis kyang*/ 'bul ba dang zhabs tog rang rang gi rdzas kyi sum gnyis phyag tu btang nas thar pa'i lam sna zin par gyur zhes pa'i snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs thams cad du grags par gyur to// de ltar dpon slob phan tshun thugs yid 'dres par gyur cing*/ dgongs pa'i don thams cad ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du grub ste/ slar yang gdan sa chen por kha lo bsgyur ba'i gsol ba btab pas/| gnang sbyin rgya chen pos bkur sti dang ldan par mdzad/ phyag phyi drung 'khor rnams la yang bab thob dang mthun pa'i gnang sbyin gyis yid kyi dga' ba skye bar mdzad do/| /|de nas bra bo dang rong po sogs kyi gdan 'dren dang bstun nas byang phyogs su chibs kha sgyur bar mdzad pa'i thog mar bra bo dang rong po rnams kyi 'bul ba zhabs tog bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa'i khri la blangs te/ rang rang gi longs spyod rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la sogs pa chos kyi 'brel pa rnams zhus nas gang yod kyi 'bul ba byas shing*/

rje nyid kyis kyang*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas 'debs par mdzad do// de nas byang ris kyi ru ba rnams rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas phyogs gcig 'dus par gyur te/ de dag thams cad kyi nan tan chen pos gdan 'dren zhus pas/ de rnams kyi zhu ba dang du blangs nas 'gro ba'i don phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ rim pa ltar phebs nas/ de rnams kyang skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed yig drug la sogs pa'i lam rnam par dag pa la 'khod par mdzad cing*/ ru sde so so nas rta dang dre'u dang mdzo pho mo la sogs pa rkang bzhi'i tshogs dang*/ mar thud la sogs te/| sa phyogs thams cad bkang ba'i 'bul ba phul ba rnams bzhes shing*/ thams cad kyang bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab ste/ tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen por spel bar mdzad/ so so'i sde rigs mi mthun pa rnams kyang 'dum pa dang*/ 'khon med par thams cad mthun pa'i lam la bkod de/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du phebs nas bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rlabs po che rgyun mi 'chad cing rim gnyis kyi thugs dam zab mos dus 'da' bar mdzad do// de'i bar skabs zhig tu/| yar rgyab dpon chen pa la yang sne gdong gong ma chen pos/ phyir ltas kyi dogs pa chen po'i gzhi yod pa'i steng du/ de'i snyad 'dogs kyang rnyed nas/ khrims gtam chen po bsgrags shing*/ gzhis kha mthar rgyas su re zhig ngal gso byin pa'i 'og tu gshed ma bskos pa'i gtam thos nas shin tu skrag pa chen pos bzhin gyi mdangs med par rtab rtab pos 'dir thar byung ba la/ chen po la 'os pa'i sne len dang*/ gsung gi gnang ba zab cing rgya che ba gsal ba'i dbugs phyung shing sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad cing*/ dpon g.yog thams cad mthun rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa lo 'ga'i bar du gnang nas/ phyag phyir 'jog par mdzad pa'i steng du/

rin spungs pas gdan 'dren byung ba la/ khong rang gi thugs 'dod dang bstun nas chibs drel la sogs bzang mang gi sgar chas dang*/ chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin dang bcas te nyen med kyi sar skyel bar mdzad de/ 'di lta bu la sogs pa mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyin pa bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yang rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'o// gzhan yang bdag cag 'gro ba lha mi'i skyabs gnas dam pa chos kyi rje rin po che 'di ni/ sngon rgyal ba'i gsung rab la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa'i stobs kyis sku tshe 'dir yang*/ gsung rab ji lta bu zhig yin kyang*/ gzigs pa tsam gyis don thogs med du mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhan la 'doms pa la'ang*/| bag tsha ba dang thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ spobs pa mi zad pa'i sgo nas dpe don dang*/ lung rigs du ma dang bcas te ston par mdzad pas gdul bya'i blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par byed nus pa dang*/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi brtul zhu+ugs 'dzin pa la gtso bor mdzad cing*/ thub dbang gi bcas mtshams las 'gal ba'i nyes pa phra mo tsam yang mi 'byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ rmi lam du yang 'chal khrims ma lus pa spangs nas/ gzhan dag re re yang bsnyen rdzogs dang rab tu byung ba byed par 'dod pa la thugs shin tu dgyes pa chen po dang bcas te mthun rkyen sbyar ba'i sgo nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la sbyor bar mdzad pa sogs dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa 'phel ba'i thabs la thugs lhag par brtson pa yin no// gzhan yang dam pa 'di nyid mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi blo gros thogs pa med pa mnga' ba'i stobs kyis man ngag gi bstan bcos zab cing rgya che ba mdzad pa'i rim pa mdo tsam zhig smos pa ni/ thog mar mos gus srog gi 'khor lo'i man ngag mi gsal bar bla ma'i zhal las shes dgos pa rnams kyi gnad legs par bkrol nas gsal bar byed pa'i khrid rim mdzad/|

de dang 'brel bar lnga ldan rin po che gsal byed dang*/ khams nas rje nyid kyi thugs sras puṇ+ya sa mu dras zhus pa'i lan/ dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams gsal bar byed pa'i dris lan 'od stong ldan pa dang*/ ri bo che pa'i sgom chen bsod rnams grub kyis phyi nang gi khyad par dang*/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par/| sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par bskyed rim gyi khyad par sogs zhib tu phye ba zhus pa'i lan/ lung rigs man ngag sgrub yig gi gnad du mas brgyan pa dang*/ stag lung sgom chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhus len gegs sel bogs 'don gyi gnad dang*/ khyad par thig le'i gegs sel gyi gnad dang bcas pa mdzad/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig dang*/ de'i rgyab skyor rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa tshigs su bcad pa mdzad/ khams skyo'i bla ma gnyis kyis skul ba'i ngor chos drug 'chad thabs kyi man ngag sbas don kun gsal mdzad/ gling kha dar rgyas rtser bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis/ rje nyid kyis thugs dam du bzhes shing*/ yab mes rnams kyis kyang de la mnga' brnyes pa'i yi dam gyi rtsa ba zhig dgos zhus pa'i ngor rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub dkyil dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo mdzad/ bde mgon gyi las rim gsal ba'i sgron me bya ba phyi rabs la phan pa'i don du mdzad/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma mched lnga'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel zhes bya ba gdung rabs rnams phrin las mnga' brnyes pa'i don du mdzad/ phyag chen chos drug gi gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma sgrub sde'i rtogs ldan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad/ rje nyid kyi gsang ba dang shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar/ nang so rgya mtsho bas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa sogs mgo smos pa tsam mo// rgyas par blta bar 'dod na de dang de dag gi rim pa phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa las shes par bya'o// gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/

spyir rje btsun 'di nyid dang*/ bla ma mkha' 'gro sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang tshu rol mthong ba'i snang ngor cung zad tsam smos pa ni/ rnam thar 'di nyid kyi stod smad thams cad la khyab par yod pas/ de dag las rtogs par bya dgos so/ /deng 'dir bdag cag gi bla ma ma lus shing*/| lus pa med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na g.yo ba de'i rnam par snang ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ mkhyen gnyis thar pa'i gru bo chen pos/ 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i rten gcig pu pa/| mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir sngon chad ma byung bar mi 'gyur ba'i rten gyi mchog ye shes kyi rnam par rol pa chen po'i mdangs bkra zhing sku lnga'i zer 'phro ba mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu bkram par mdzad de/ lus can thams cad bla na med par byang chub la 'god par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis sgo mang yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i dga' ston 'gyed par bzhed nas/ cung zad thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha'i mthar thug par 'od zer gyi snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad cing*/ 'od zer de nyid slar 'dus te/ nyid kyi sku la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mdzod spu'i gnas su thim par gyur zhes grags so// de'i tshe rje 'jig rten gsum mgon/ sgam po gdar gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i dus mngon sum du/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i pho brang tsā ri'i ri bo dag pa shel ri zhes bya ba'i ngos la/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhing gi bkod pa rab 'byams bkram zhing de dag gi don ma tshang ba med cing lhun gyis grub par bstan nas/ longs sprul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo/ tha mal pa rnams kyis kyang mngon sum du mjal bar nus pa'i me long*/

rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang 'di nyid ji lta bar gzigs snang gi gtan la phab nas/ slar 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du kha lo sgyur zhing*/ sprul pa'i lha bzo ba/ ma ṇi bha dra 'khor dang bcas pa 'bod par mdzad nas/ rgyu yi khyad par lha dang mi'i rin po che mtha' dag gi bang mdzod kha phye nas/ 'og tu rin po che'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lte bar lhun sdug cing byin chags pa'i mchod sdong chen po bang rim du ma dang ldan pa'i rtse mor bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams bkra bar mdzad pa nas/ logs zur rnams la longs sprul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa bkra bar mdzad pa'i lha grangs nyis stong dang brgyad brgya steng du gser gdugs dga' ba 'khyil ba/ yang rtser gser thog gser 'phru gser bya dang bcas pas kun nas mdzes par mdzad de/ 'gro kun tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i rten du/ 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas 'dir bzhugs par mdzad/ de la dpe blangs pa'i gdung rgyud na rim gyis kyang mang du bzhengs pa/ da lta'i bar du yang rgyun mi 'chad par byung zhing*/ sgo mang de thams cad las rgya che zhing dpangs mtho la rgyu yi khyad par yang shin tu bzang shing rgya che ba dang bcas pa zhig bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa shar ba'i tshul ni/ slar yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po gdul bya'i me long la 'char bar mdzad pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'dis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams rnam grol gyi lam la 'god pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' drin gsab pa'i phyir/ rten bkra shis sgo mang bkod pa sngar nas yod pa rnams dang 'dra ba las/| rgya dpangs khyad par du gyur pa/ 'dzam gling gangs can gyi sa phyogs su byon pa'i rten gcig la ya mtshan pa zhig bzhengs par thugs thag chod nas/ thog mar lha bzo ba bi shwa karma'i lag rtsal la 'gran par nus pa/

deng sang rgya dkar nag bal bod sogs thams cad du bzo rigs la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa'i lha bzo chen mo de nyid kyi sprul par yang yongs su grags pa dpon g.yog sum cu tham pa/ slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas lung*/ jo bo be ga bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul chen po dang nye zhing tsā ri ye shes 'khor lo'i nub sgo/ rig byed mkhas pa'i skyes bu du mas gang ba'i sa phyogs byar zhes bya ba nas 'gugs par mdzad de/ dmar ser can zhes bya ba me mo sbrul gyi lo/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin/| gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po dang ldan par/ mtshungs med chos kyi rje rin po che nyid kyi phyag phyir lha bzo ba rnams khrid de/ thig tshad len par phebs pa'i nyin/| nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'od kyi gur khang chen po'i nang du me tog gi char chen po dri ngad dang ldan par babs shing*/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang dang*/| sgo mang gi bar 'ja' tshon gyis legs par sbrel te/ ri bo'i ngos kun kyang mtshon ris shin tu bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon gyis yol ba bres pa ltar gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar zhing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du mas skye dgu rnams kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad nas/ phyag tshad rnams legs par blangs te/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim sngar gong las legs par spar zhing*/ grub chen brgyad cu nas chos skyong ba'i srung ma gter mgon gyi bar/ lha grangs sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig spar ba'i zhal bkod kyi khyad par rnams kyang legs par mdzad de/ zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gcig la lha khang chen mor bzo thab btsugs shing*/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin par bzo rigs thams cad la byin rlabs rgya chen po mdzad/ de'i dus thams cad du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char chen po yang babs/

than pa'i dus yin pa la/ beng lcam dral gyi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon sum du bstan cing char gyi rgyun chen po yang babs so// de ltar rgyu'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i tshe yang*/ ltas dang cho 'phrul bzang po/| dus las yol ba'i 'brug sgra ngo mtshar can grags pa la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po rnams kyi bskul ba ltar/ bzo rigs pa rnams la dad pa'i mos gus khyad par can 'khrungs pas/ nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par bzo'i las la spro ba dang ldan pas yid gzhungs par gyur nas rje nyid kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa la phan tshun 'gran pa ltar gyur pas thams cad yid 'phrog par mdzad do// de'i dus nas bzo bo rnams la zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur gyi khyad par dus bzhi dang bstun pa'i sgo nas bza' ba dang*/| bca' ba dang btung ba la sogs pa yul mi gcig pa'i lugs kyi bye brag rang rang gi yid la ji ltar 'bab pa rnams phongs pa med par mdzad/ gos dang mal stan sogs kyang dbyar dgun dang mthun pa'i sbyor lugs dang*/ rang rang gang la ci dgos kyi 'dod yon dang*/ bran g.yog la sogs pa rnams kyang*/ bu gcig pa la ma ltar brtse zhing byams pas skyong ba ltar mdzad pa yin no// zla re bzhin du/ dus ston gyi khyad par bzang po dang*/ de'i gnang sbyin ja bzang dang gos dar dang*/ gser dngul dang*/ rta drel la sogs pa rang rang yid kyi 'dod pa thams cad tshim zhing skye bo phal po ches mthong na blor mi shong ba dang*/ lhag par dus chen rnams la rje nyid kyi rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i skyes mchog khang gsar nang so'i sde srid kyi khur bzung nas rje rin po che'i zhabs rim sgrub pa'i gtso bo byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bas thog drangs/ khang gsar nang so'i dpon che chung gnyer las 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams kyis rje rin po che'i thog drangs dpon mo che pa rnams la/ ston mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsnyen bkur ba'i steng du/

ka ru ma'i 'bul ba bzang zhing gya nom pa dang*/ bu chen dang slob ma drung 'khor longs spyod che ba rnams dang*/ yul so so'i dpon che chung*/ byang bod kyi sde dgon dang bcas pa rnams kyis khur blangs pa'i dpal 'byor rgya chen pos bsnyen bkur 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas so// 'di lta bu'i rten bzhengs kyi snyan pa'i grags pas sa 'og dang sa steng sa bla thams cad du bkram pa ltar khyab par gyur pas/ rgya nag nas gong ma rgyal po'i 'bul cha'i thog drangs/ bsam blo nang so/ sngo phur kha brgyad sogs rgya nag gi phyogs nas dad thob kyi bu chen rnams kyi rta dang dre'u ja dang gos dar gyi 'bul snod bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'bul dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan pas thog drangs 'bul dpon rnams kyis phyag tu smin par byas shing 'dan ma'i 'bul dpon kun dga' shes rab dang*/ klu dbang rgya mtsho sogs kyi rta dang dre'u dang*/ ja gos dar/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i 'bul snod kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas rgyal po rnams kyis thog drangs/ rdor 'dzin chen po so so'i bla ma grwa bu slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang so so nas/ gser dngul zangs gsum dang*/ sman dang ras cha dang mchod cha'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul dpon kun dga' shes rab dang byams pa seng ge sogs kyis dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas rin po che'i bang mdzod 'gengs par mdzad do// gzhis kha rin spungs pas thog drangs pa'i dbus gtsang gi sde pa phal cher gyis kyang shin tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas yo byad mkho dgu'i zhabs tog bsgrubs shing*/ khyad par spyan snga zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i gnang sbyin gyis thog drangs/ stag lung chos rje khu dbon sogs dbus gtsang gi bla ma che dgu phal cher gyis kyang dad pa'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa char ltar babs so// gzhan yang dwags lha sgam po'i chos rje/

spu bo chos rje sogs lho phyogs kyi bla ma che chung grwa bu slob dang bcas pa dang*/ kong po'i phyogs kyi grwa pa yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dwags po'i sde dpon kun rab pa 'khor bcas dang*/ gnas chen tsā rir bzhugs pa'i rdor 'dzin gyis thog drangs las tshan bco brgyad la sogs te/| phyogs bcu'i chos rje rnam pa/ bla ma slob dpon/ sde bdag so so/ dmangs phal pa la sogs pa dpag tu med cing grangs las 'das pa thams cad kyis kyang dad pa dang mos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas 'bul ba phul ba ni brjod par mi nus shing bgrang gis mi lang pa'o// gzhan yang*/ nyang po dang*/ snye bo rngod dang*/| khams ri bo che sogs nas kyang gser dngul sogs 'dod dgu'i yo byad 'bab chu chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin no// rje btsun dam pa 'di/ thugs rje dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i shugs tshad med pa'i stobs kyi/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ma zhugs shing gdul bya'i gnas su ma gyur pa'i nag po hor rnams kyis kyang*/ rje btsun nyid dang rten bkra shis sgo mang gi grags pa chen pos sa steng khyab par gyur pas yid rab tu mgu zhing dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yos te/ thams cad kyi dngos po'i khyad par bzang zhing rgya che ba phul nas/ de rnams la yang thar pa'i sa bon thebs pa ni rmad du byung ba las kyang ches rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa yin no// de nas thog mar bzo thams cad kyi phud la/ mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud zhes grags pa'i 'od zer chen pos nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mun pa sel ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i bshes gnyen dam par gyur pa/ rgyal ba'i mdo sde du ma nas/ sngon gyi dus na me tog zla mdzes/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nu/ gangs ri'i khrod du snying po don gyi bstan pa'i bdag po sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa'i dge slong 'tsho byed bya bar lung bstan cing*/

sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs par gyur pas/ sangs rgyas stong gi zhal ston cing*/ sku brgya phrag du mar sprul pa la sogs pa'i mchog gi grub rtags dpag med ston cing sku gsum mngon du gyur pa'i sems dpa' chen po/ gangs can gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa mnyam med dwags po rin po che la/ rje btsun 'di nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob ste yang yang zhal mjal zhing gsung gi gnang ba yang dpag tu med pa thob pas/ de'i bka' drin gsab pa'i phyir/ rgyu bzang zhing zhal bkod kyi khyad par ngo mtshar bar mdzad pa/ dpon mo che pas kyang dad cing gus pas dang du blangs te/ dus myur ba byon legs pa rang byon lta bu legs par grub pa la/ nang bzhugs yang mdo rgyud dang mthun pa byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i rten ring bsrel khyad par can bzhugs pa la/ rab tu gnas pa yang rje btsun dam pa nyid kyi thog drangs dge slong gi dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ mdo rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin legs par grub pa'i mthar phyin gyi shis pa brjod pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/ lha dang mkha' 'gros me tog gi char chen pos gang bar byas pa sogs/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te legs par grub ste/| rten bkra shis sgo mang bar chad med par grub pa'i rten 'brel thams cad 'di nas 'grig pa'o// de nas 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje nas nyi zla bya ru'i bar gyi mchod sdong chen po'i ma khog gi skye mched dang 'phrul las grub pa'i lha rnams legs par grub cing*/ de nas lugs ma'i gtso bo/ nyi zla bya ru dang bcas pa la bzhugs pa'i chos rje bla ma'i dngul sku chen mo/ dngul srang sum cu las legs par grub pa/ phyag tshad dang ldan pa/ khri dang rgyab yol zangs gser las grub pa/ skye mched sogs dpon mo che pas bzo gnye bzung tsam ma gtogs rang byon gyi tshul du byung bas/ dpon mo che ba yang shin tu ngo mtshar te/

nang bzhugs rab gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad nas me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/ dngul sku de nyid las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga phyogs thams cad du 'phro ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub cing*/ me tog gi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur la sogs pa kun gyi yid 'phrog par mdzad cing thams cad dad pa'i mtsho chen gang bar gyur pa lags so// de ltar bkra shis sgo mang gi phyi mo la/ lha nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa las/ sgo mang gsar bzhengs 'di nyid la sngar gong las lhag pa'i lha grangs byon tshul ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim la grub thob brgyad cu'i grangs ldan dang*/ rje nyid mos pa'i grub chen 'ga' zhig dang*/ rje btsun nyid kyi bka' drin che ba'i bla ma bcu gnyis dang*/ rje nyer gnyis rin po che phyin chod kyi gdung rgyud rin po che dad thob kyi sku rnams dang*/ gter mgon gyi bar du lha sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'phar ba grangs pa'i sum stong dang*/ brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi grangs dang ldan pa rnams la so so'i nang bzhugs kyi rim pa/ bla ma grub chen gong ma rnams kyi gdung ring bsrel/ dbu skra phyag sen phyag phreng byin rlabs can rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi ring bsrel rtsod pa med pa dang*/ lha che ba rnams la gzungs kyi bye brag tshang ma nyis 'gyur dang sum 'gyur/| 'bring rnams la yang gzungs chen grags che ba rnams dang*/ chung ngu 'phrul ma rnams kyi nang du'ang*/ rang rang gi gzungs chung gi khyad par rnams lañja dang 'ba' 'bru sngags kyi rnam pa ji ltar 'os 'os sogs dang*/ gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor yan chod kyi nang bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams go rim ma 'chol zhing ma 'khrugs la mtshan nyid dang ldan par rje nyid kyi zhal bkod kyi khyab par mdzad nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing*/ tshul khrims dang sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa/

rje nyid las bka' drin thob pas/ mos gus dang dam tshig gtsang ba rnams kyis legs par bsgrubs shing*/ rim bzhin du grub pa dang bstun nas rab gnas kyang rim can du mdzad pa yin no// 'bri gung pa'i sde srid la/ bar skabs bar skabs su/ 'ol kha ba stag gsher dang bcas pas zhabs 'dren mang du bsgrubs pas/ de'i dus kyi tshe/| rje nyid kyi blon chen sku 'khor ba 'ga' zhig gis thugs la mi bzod pa'i zhe sdang ste rje btsun dam pa nyid la gsol ba 'di skad ces btab bo// mkhyen rtse nus pa dang ldan pa'i rje btsun khyed lta bus bstan pa la gnod pa'i bdud dpung gi tshogs thams cad tshar ma bcad na/ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa/| dgos su rang re 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa la gnod tshabs che drags yong ba 'dug pas/ bar skabs su drag po'i phrin las sgrub tshul re yang gnang dgos zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi snang srid dbang du 'dus pa'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus shing*/ stong gsum bran du 'khol ba'i ting nge 'dzin phrin las bzhi la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas rim can du/ 'bri gung pa dpon g.yog 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad/ rten bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa'i sgang bdo ba'i tshe/ 'ol kha stag rtse ba'i rdzong dpon gyi gtsos pa'i skya ser gyi dpung shin tu stobs che ba 'bri gung pa'i sde srid la mtho 'tsham par chas nas/| 'bri gung mthil la yang lag rgyag bya'o zhes gleng zhing yid la yang bsams te/ rings pa'i tshul du 'ongs te/ mal gro gung dkar du sleb pa'i skabs zhig na/| rang re 'bri gung pa'i sde srid kyi dmag dpung kyang tshogs te/ dpal mi yi dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan pas kha lo bsgyur nas/ tshur 'gebs byung dogs kyi mda' rag che bar yod pa las/ dus de nyid du/ nyang po gzhi nang nas yin zer ba'i bang chen pa mi gnyis rtab rtab por byung nas/

kong po nas nged rang gi dmag dpung gtos che ba/ nyang po stod phyogs la 'grims 'ong gin yod pas/ 'di phyogs kyi dmag chen yang*/ nyin mtshan shod la/ 'ol kha ba'i sgar la stod la 'grims byon zer ba zhig byung bas/ rje rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ da len gyi dmag gi 'gro sdod ji ltar legs kyi zhu skor btang bas/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhal nas/ mdang sang kho bo sku mtshams bcad rgya ma shin tu dam pa'i dus shig na/ lha 'o de gung rgyal gyis zang zing gi 'bul ba mang po dang*/| khyad par lug khyu mang po phul byung ba la/ chos kyi 'brel ba bshad btang ba zhig byung ba de/ tshar chod kyi rnam par 'dug pas/ dpung song ba la/ da res nyes pa gcig kyang med pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa byung bas/ de ga'i mod la dmag dpung bteg nas phyin dus/ 'ol kha ba dpon g.yog gi mthong snang la/ dmag dpung shin tu che ba/ ban dmag mang pos sna drangs te/ mig gis blta mi phod pa tsam byung bar mthong bas/ ha cang bla 'dar te/ ci bya gtol med par gyur ro// de nas rang re'i dpung rnams 'ol kha ba'i sgar sar sleb nas skor ma thag shi bsad med par dpon g.yog mi nor thams cad lag tu byung ngo*// de nas 'ol kha ba'i rdzong dpon dpon g.yog drag pa 'ga' zhig bu gter khrid/ mang ma thams cad tshe thar la btang ste/ nom pa dang gtam snyan gyi sa phyogs thams cad khyab par byas so// de'i tshe sde bdag chen po mgon po rgyal mtshan pa 'khor bcas/ rje btsun nyid kyi zhabs drung du phebs te/ dmag byus shin tu nas rgyal ba la brten pa'i ngo so'i rnam pa cung zad yod pa las/| rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhal nas/ rtsed mo thabs su/ nged kyi dmag dpung thams cad a phyi chos kyi sgron mas sna drangs/ dmar po dgra zor gyis mdun nas bdar/ ye shes mgon pos rgyab rten byas brdzangs yod pa yin/ dmag thog tu song ba tsho/

de tsam ha las pa'i ngo so mi dgos so ang*/ zhes pa'i bzhad gad kyi rol rtsed gnang byung ba de/ thugs shin tu bden par 'dug dus de skabs su kong dmag mi gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ nyang po gzhi nang nas yongs zer ba'i bang chen gnyis po de/ chos skyong gi sprul pas skul bar thag chod pa'o// de dus 'ol kha bas ban dmag mthong ba dmar po dgra zor yin no/| /|de nas sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad pa'i dpung gi tshogs thams cad kyis/ 'phan yul mkhar rtse ba'i grogs ldan la byon nas/ zhag 'ga' skabs kyi nyin gcig rje btsun dam pa de nyid phyed thun la bzhugs dus/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma byon pa/ sngar yin na zhal ras shin tu dkar ba las/ de'i nyin g.yas phyogs cung zad nag pa'i gsung gis/ nyid kyi dgongs pa la dpon g.yog byes song rnams la nyes dmigs byung dogs 'khrungs 'dug ste/ skyon du 'gyur ba ni med/| ye rang kyang brtan byus kyi 'gro 'ong yod dus mi gtong ba/ nged rang gi srid pos bshol bcag par 'dug ces bka' bkyon pa'i tshul gsungs byung bas/ de nas ma 'gyangs par dbus gtsang gi chings chen grub pas/ dmag dpung 'gyes dgos pa byung ngo*// de dus chings de mdzad ma byung na/ bstan pa 'phel rgyas 'di las che ba zhig yong rgyur 'dug ces pa yang rje btsun nyid gsung ngo*// de ltar bshad pa'i dgra bgegs ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad cing*/ dbang du bsdu ba'i khur chen bsnams pa'i zhabs 'bring ba ni blon po rin chen lta bu blo gros dang ldan pa/ dpa' zhing ngal ba med pa brtul zhugs kyi mnga' bdag mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sde srid kyi khur bzung ste bsgrubs pa'o// de ltar gong du bstan pa'i dgra bo gdug pa can/ 'ol kha ba la sogs pa rnams ni/ sems rmugs pa dang*/| yan lag rengs pa dang*/ lus 'gugs pa dang*/ dbang du bsdu ba'i las tsam ni mdzad/

srog dang bral ba'i las ni ma mdzad pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te gnas skabs su/ bzhugs gnas dang zhabs tog sogs kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang nas/ thugs brtse ba chen pos/ mthar rang gnas su/| zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya chen po dang bcas te/ skyel bar mdzad pa yin no// 'di lta bu'i mdzad pa ni/ gnod len du phan btags pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa shin tu mchog tu gyur pa yin no// de ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi bzhengs pa'i rten gcig la ngo mtshar ba bkra shis sgo mang 'di 'byon pa'i lhongs tshad bdud kyi bar chad kyi rnam pa/ 'ol kha ba'i dmag chen 'dren pa dang*/ lha bzo dpon mo che 'ga' gdon gyi gnod pa phran tshegs byung ba sogs/ bar chod kyi rnam pa cung zad byung yang*/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi thugs rje'i nus pas zil gyis mnan cing*/ stod mnga' ris dang bar dbus gtsang dang*/ smad mdo khams dang*/ rgya dkar nag dang byang hor la sogs te phyogs thams cad nas/ phyi nang gi longs spyod kyi 'bul snod dpag tu med pa/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du zad pa med par 'bab pa'i ngang nas/| dpon mo che pa rnams kyang thugs dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po'i sgo nas bzo'i las la brtson par bzhugs so// de dag gi don smras pa/ rdo rje'i don rtogs snyigs dus rdo rje 'chang*// sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag kun dga' rin chen 'dis// dbang bzhi'i zab don chos la dbang sgyur bas// tshad med rnam bzhis phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub/| /|rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bstan// snang srid dbang bsgyur rje btsun 'di nyid la// dad cing mos pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs// mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// bde chen thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi'i bstan pa spel ba la// rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di nyid rje btsun nyid kyi phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i rnam par thar pa la ngo mtshar dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las/|

rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pas phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i mdzad pa dgu pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas rang gi gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnams la/ zab don man ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa nyams len la dril ba'i gnad/ rjes kyi mjug bsdud dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste/ zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i zhal chems shugs 'byung du bstan pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa ni/ de nas rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid/ dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes pa lug gi lo la spyir dgung skeg la phebs pa dang*/ khyad par rten bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa'i rgyab chog la ched du gtad pa'i thugs dam rim gnyis la g.yel ba med par bzhugs so// de la dam pa 'di nyid spyir chos sku mnyam nyid bde ba chen po rang rig pa'i ye shes las ma g.yos bzhin du/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs dam spros bcas 'chag med rgyun du mdzad pa'i rim pa/ rje rang gi gsang ba'i rnam thar las gsungs pa ni/ da lta kho bos thun bar thams cad du gnas lugs la bzhag nas/| yul snang dang bsre ba ste/ sgom pa'i blo dang bral yang*/ shor thob kyi snyem med tsam du snang ngo*// mtshan bcas kyi rim pa lnga thun dang po'i dus su/ rdo rje'i glus bskul nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i ngang nas/ he ru ka sngon po lhan skyes su bsgom pa'i rim pa gnyis dang bzlas pa/ bar du rgya gar dzo ki'i bsrung bzlog dang tshe sgrub/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bsrung bzlog dang rdzas sngags/ sgom chen klu mes kyi tshe sgrub/ yang tshe sgrub ras chung lugs/ rlung dgang ba/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ mgon dkar/ rga lo dang rtswa mi lugs kyi tshe sgrub/

gu ru mtsho skyes lugs kyi sgrub thabs chen mo/| gcod la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor las/ snga thun dang po sde mgon gyi mngon dkyil sgrub thabs/ 'khor lo gcig ma/ mos gus srog 'khor gyi las tshogs/| thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo/ gtum mo sum rtsegs/ gsang bdag 'gro bzang snying po dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rnams byed/| langs nas phyag mchod bsdus pa/ tsha thog tu rje gsum ldan ma dang*/ rjes dran rnams 'chag med/ gung tshigs la rjes dran gro gtor/ gcod kyi gung thun/| dgong mo'i skabs su gcod thun/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun gtor cha bcu/ bskangs gtor sogs phrin las tshang ma/ de'i rjes su gshin rje'i bsrung bzlog sher snying seng gdong sogs bzlog pa/ mtshan brjod sogs mdo phran las gzungs rnams grub rjes/ phyag mchod/ srod la gcod kyi thun tha ma/ ye shes mgon po'i 'khor lo lnga ma'i dmar khrid/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i bar dang*/ nyal dmigs rnams te/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dge sbyor ro// zla ba byung ngo cog gi bco lnga la brgya phyag 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i gso sbyong*/ sems bskyed len pa/ sngags sdom la rigs lnga sdom bzung dang*/ de'i nyin sman lha mdo chog 'jam sdus smon gsum bzlas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu la 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ma/ mar ngo'i bcu la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma/ nyer dgu la dgu gtor gsol 'debs rin chen sgron ma tshang ma rnams byed pa'o// de dag ni shin tu ches gsang ba'i rnam thar te/ rab tu sba bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di dag bla ma chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho bas zhus pa la gnang ba'o// de lta bu'i thugs dam rim gnyis kyi nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang nas/| phyag dpe gzigs pa dang*/ chos gsung ba sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i mdzad phrin kho nas dus 'da' zhing*/

'jig rten 'di'i snang ba ni ming gi lhag ma tsam du mdzad do// de ltar nang du thugs dam khyad par can gyi rtogs pa mnga' ba'i stobs kyis/ phyi rol tu nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa na dngos su khol ba dang*/| ye shes mgon po dang a phyi chos kyi sgron ma la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi bka' nyan cing phrin las bsgrub pa dang*/ lung ston pa la sogs pa yang mdzad pa lags so// de nas rje btsun dam pa 'gro ba'i 7skyabs mgon chos kyi rje kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid/ dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa shing pho spre'u'i lo la u rgyan pad+ma'i sgrub gnas/ ti sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i tshogs khang chen mor gzhan phan gyi sgrub pa snying po don gyi nyams len la yun ring du bzhugs nas/| phyir phebs lam gyi lung bstan tsha chu la sogs te/ de skor gyi chu bo dang chu phran dang*/ mtshe'u mtha' dag yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ hūm̐ dang pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog pa/| gur gum mdog can dwangs shing yid 'phrog pa/ dri bzang gi ngad pa 'thul bas phyogs thams cad khyab pa sogs/ ltas ngo mtshar can bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sde
